She’s just before His throne,
Where, she’ll reign with her Lord forevermore.

title: SHOUTING ON THE HILLS OF GLORY
lyrics:
What a happy time is coming,
When we'll reach our home in heaven,
And the burdens which we bore, we'll bear no more,
When the Angel sound the trumpet;
Calling us to those bright mansions,
There will be shouting on the everlasting shore.

Chorus

There’ll be shouting on the Hills of Glory,
Shouting on the hills, Yes! Shouting on the hills,
When we've reach the land;
Of which we've heard the story,
There'll be shouting on the everlasting shore,
(There’s gonna be shouting on the hills of Glory)

When the saints begin to gather,
Round the throne in that bright city,
And the angel's choir the song of praise uphold;
Hearts of joy will then be ringing,
Saints of all the ages singing
Such a meeting as you never saw before.

title: THE DAY, THOU GAVEST
lyrics:
The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

We thank Thee that Thy Church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

As o'er each continent and island,
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

The sun that bids us rests is waking,
Our brethren 'neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making,
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

So be it, Lord! Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy Kingdom stands and grows for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

title: I’M GOING HOME, I'LL SOON BE GONE
lyrics:
There’s a road that’s strait and narrow,
That I am travelling on,
The great mystery unfolding to His Bride alone,
I’m a stranger in this world, I know I don’t belong,
And I’m on my way to Glory, I’m going home.

Chorus

I’m going home, I’ll soon be gone,
I am on my way to Glory where I belong,
I’m going home, I’ll soon be gone,
He is here to take me with Him,
I’ll soon be gone.

I hear my Heavenly Father say,
"Child I’m placing you",
I knew you before the foundation,
Before the world began;
He said, “All the Father has given,
I will not lose one”
And I’m on my way to Glory, I’m going home.

title: YOU CAN COUNT ON HIM
lyrics:
If you could count the stars, that have shone above,
If you could count the sand by the sea,
And you could count the waves that have,
Lapped the shore from creation to eternity;
Still to count the ways God cares for you,
You''ll never reach the sum,
And there's this one thing you can be sure,
You can count on Him.

Chorus

You can count on Him (2x),
When you feel alone and the chips are down,
And you're out of strength,
He's the Truth, the Life and the Shining Light;
When the way grows dim,
Put your faith to use and you just can't lose,
You can count on Him.

Have you counted someone as your closest friend,
And found that he was not true,
Have you trusted someone to keep his word,
And what he said, he didn't do;
Now there's someone knocking at your heart's door,
Why don't you let Him in,
Jesus wants to be your faithful friend,
And you can count on Him.

title: I'M BORN AGAIN
lyrics:
Satan tells me that I only thought I got saved,
He tells me what a fool I have been,
But when my mind goes back to that place,
Where I prayed, I know that I’m born again.

Chorus

Born again, free from sin,
I’m happy night and day,
It makes me shout, there’s no doubt,
I know that I’m born again.

Many times along the way,
My faith has grown weak,
When burdens seem to rise on every hand;
But when I go away in pray’rs, He answers my plea,
My every need He understands.

title: JUST SAY THE RIGHT WORD
lyrics:
Many years ago a woman named Mary,
Received a visit from an angel of the Lord,
She said "Be it unto me, according to Thy word",
She said the right thing,
And the promise was given to her,

CHORUS:
Just say the right word and what you ask will be given,
Just approach Him with the right attitude,
Hattie Wright said "That's the truth, Brother Branham"
She said the right word, her sons received Eternal Life.

“Around nine hundred denominations", claim they're His Bride,
They all say that He's coming back for them,
But the showdown is gonna tell who belongs to Him,
She'll say the right word,
The rapture will take her away from here.

title: OH! MY COMRADE
lyrics:
Oh! My comrades! see the signals, waving in the sky!
Reinforcements now appearing, victory is nigh!

Chorus

"Hold the fort, for I am coming!"
Jesus signals still;
Wave the answer back to heaven,
"By Thy grace we will!"

See! The mighty host advancing, Satan leading on;
Mighty men around us falling, Courage almost gone!

See! The glorious banner waving! Hear the trumpet blow!
In our leader's name we'll triumph, over every foe!

Fierce and long the battle rages, But our help is near;
Onward comes our Great Commander,
Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

title: ELIEZER TELL ME MORE
lyrics:
Eliezer was sent to get a bride for Isaac,
Found Rebekah in a far desert land,
She believed every word he told her;
She left home following a man,
To a place she'd never been before,
To marry a man she'd never seen;
She loved to hear him tell her about Isaac,
Following his carmel train.

CHORUS:
Eliezer tell me more, what Isaac really looks like,
I've never seen Him yet I'm to be His Bride,
He said He has a home for me;
I can't wait to walk through the door,
Oh! I wanna see Him, Eliezer tell me more.

On this journey to meet Isaac,
Rebekah said, "I'm thirsty and it's hot",
Elie-zer said, "don't worry,
Here's an " Ever Present Water from the Rock";
She said, "I'm hungry, did you bring something to eat?"
Here is some 'Spiritual Food In Due Season' for you,
I brought everything you need.

Eliezer have you seen Him, what's He really like?
Yes! I've seen Him, in a sedge field late one night,
His garment blowing in the wind, then I spoke His Name,
I said, Jesus! He turned and looked at me,
And I've never been the same.

title: I FEEL IT TUGGING
lyrics:
My anchor holds within the veil,
My anchor holds within the veil,
I feel it tugging, I feel it tugging,
My anchor holds within the veil.

My anchor holds within the veil,
My anchor holds within the veil,
I feel it pulling, I feel it pulling,
My anchor holds within the veil.

title: O! GET READY
lyrics:
T'was a day in the early spring time, by an ancient wayside well,
Eli-ezer paused to rest his camel train,
He had found a bride for Isaac, 'ere the evening shadows fell;
There his weary journey had not been in vain,
So he took the fair Rebekah, decked in jewels rich and rare,
Back to Abraham and Sarah far away;
Where Rebekah loved her Isaac and he loved Rebekah fair,
Oh! It must have been, a happy wedding day.

CHORUS:
O! Get ready, the evening shadows fall,
Don't you hear the Eli-ezer's call,
There's going to be a wedding supper,
Our joys will soon begin, in the evening,
When the camel train comes in.

The Blessed Holy Spirit, through the Prophet of this day,
Has come down to earth, to claim a worthy Bride,
For our Isaac over yonder, has prepared his tent of love;
And He wants His fair Rebekah, by His side,
We've left our kinfolks gladly, we've bade the world good bye;
We're going to a land be-yond the sea,
We shall soon behold our Isaac, in the blest eternity,
What! A happy, happy meeting that will be.

title: EL ELAH! ELOHIM
lyrics:
El Elah! Elohim!
How we long to worship You,
El Elah! Elohim!
How we long to worship You.

Lord! We come to You in worship,
No matter what the cir-cum-stance,
No matter what the si-tua-tion,
We will lift up holy hands.

title: THERE, THEY CRUCIFIED HIM
lyrics:
In the early morning, the Sun was high,
As an angry mob gathered round,
Some have come to see Him die,
Some just felt He was in town;
Was it that He just happened,
To have fallen into evil hands?
What they failed to realise,
It was or-dained in God's plan,
So there, they cru-cified Him.

CHORUS 1
THERE! The most holy city of that day,
THEY! The most religious leaders said, "Take Him away,
CRUCIFY! They did it 'cause they did not understand,
HIM! The greatest gift God ever gave to man.

It's been almost two thousand years,
Things are about the same;
To think we'll learn from their mistakes,
I guess some things just never change,
They have got Him on the cross again;
That came through evil hands,
They don't want His word today,
Like they didn't want Him then,
So there, they crucified Him.

CHORUS 2
THERE! The most holy city of that day (Jerusalem),
THEY! The most religious leaders said,
Take Him away, CRUCIFY! The Word to die,
They did it 'cuase they did not understand,
HIM! The greatest gift God ever gave to man

Long after God's promi-ses,
Have been fulfilled to-day,
People are still looking for,
What God will do in fu-ture;
Adulte-rous gene-ra-tion,
All searching for some signs;
They'll not see those signs today,
'Cause they're not in God's plan,
I'm glad, He took me in today.

CHORUS 3
Today! The most holy temples of the land (Denominations),
Today! The most religious leaders say " He is a false prophet,
(So) put Him away, don't take His word",
They do it 'cause they do not understand,
The truth, and the mani-fested plan made plain today.

title: I'M A BELIEVER
lyrics:
The asset in my bank account has fallen in the red,
So I looked into the Word, to see what God has said,
Then I claim financial blessings from Galatians. 3;
God opened up the wealth of Heaven,
And He poured it down on me.

CHORUS 1
O! I’m a believer, not a doubter,
Well! The Word of God is faithful and is true,
There’s no power that can shake me;
No problem that can break me,
I’m a believer not a doubter,
And by faith I’ve made it through.

I can still recall the time, my body ached with pain,
The shots and the pills and the doctor bills,
I had were all in vain;
Then I claim 1Pet.Chapter 2 Vs 24, my soul was thrilled,
'Cause I’d been healed, two thousand years before.

Now you may be a child of God and still be in despair,
Big dreams with doubt turned inside out, had it up to here,
You don’t have to be defeated, Satan is a fraud;
Get your eyes from off of the problem, Brother,
And get them on the Word of God.

CHORUS 2
And be a believer and not a doubter,
Well! The Word of God is faithful and is true,
There’s no problem that can sway you,
No po-wer that can shake you,
Be a believer and not a doubter,
And by faith you’ll make it through.

title: THE SHEW BREAD
lyrics:
(I‘m feeding upon the Shew Bread and I’m alright) 2x
There‘s no need to worry
In this Rebreeding (Winnowing) Season
I‘m feeding upon the Shew Bread and I’m alright

(I‘m drinking from that well, that never runs dry) 2x
There‘s no need to worry,
In this Rebreeding (Winnowing) Season
I‘m feeding upon the Shew Bread and I’m alright

title: SAFE IN THE ARMS OF JESUS
lyrics:
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'er shaded;
Sweetly my soul shall rest,
Hark! 'tis the voice of angels,
Borne in a song to me,
Over the field of Glory,
Over the Jasper Sea.

Chorus

Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'er shaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from corroding care,
Safe from the world's temptations,
Sin cannot harm me there;
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears,
Only a few more trials,
Only a few more tears.

Jesus, my heart's dear Refuge,
Jesus has died for me,
Firm on the Rock of Ages;
Ever my trust shall be,
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o'er;
Wait till I see the morning,
Break on the golden shore.

title: COMPLETE IN HIM
lyrics:
(Complete, complete
Complete in Him
We are complete in Him) 2x

(It‘s not by works of righteousness
But by His grace alone) 3x
We are complete in Him

(There is no condemnation to them
Who are in Christ Jesus) 3x
We are complete in him

(There‘s nothing more that I can do
But Jesus paid it all) 3x
I am complete in Him

title: WONDERFUL STORY OF LOVE
lyrics:
Wonderful story of love,
Tell it to me again,
Wonderful story of love;
Wake the immortal strain!
Angels with rapture announce it,
Shepherds with wonder receive it;
Sinner, O! Won't you believe it,
Wonderful story of love.

Chorus

Won....der....full! Won....der....full!
Won...der...full!
Wonderful story of love!

Wonderful story of love;,
Though you are far away,
Wonderful story of love;
Still He doth call to-day,
Calling from Calvary's mountain,
Down from the crystal bright fountain;
Eve' from the dawn of creation,
Wonderful story of love.

Wonderful story of love,
Jesus provides a rest,
Wonderful story of love;
For all the pure and blest,
Rest in those mansions above us,
With those who 've gone on before us;
Singin' the rapturous chorus,
Won-der-ful story of love.

title: I OWE MY LIFE TO THE CRUCIFIED
lyrics:
Lord! Where would I be, if You had not gone,
Up that lonely hill to dark Calvary,
What is man that the King would leave,
His glo-ry above and suffered in deep agony,

Chorus

I owe my whole life to the Crucified One,
Who gave His all for me, with all that's in me,
I will praise His Holy Name,
Praise God for the Crucified One.

He walked that lonely hill with me in mind,
I was wretched, naked and blind;
My Lord was so brave, only one to bear
Thank God for the Crucified One.

title: I GAVE MY LIFE FOR THEE
lyrics:
I gave my life for thee,
My pre-cious blood I shed,
That thou mightest ran-somed be,
And quick-ened from the dead,
(I gave, I gave My life for thee,
What hast thou done for Me)? 2x

My Fa-ther's house of light,
My glo-ry - cir-cled throne,
I left for earth-ly night,
For wan-d'rings, sad and lone,
(I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me)? 2x

I suf-fered much for thee,
More than thy tongue can tell,
Of bit-t'rest ag-o-ny,
To res-cue thee from hell,
(I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me)? 2x

And I have brought to thee,
Down from My home a-bove,
Sal-va-tion full and free,
My par-don and My love,
(I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee,
What hast thou brought to Me)? 2x

title: RISE AND BE HEALED
lyrics:
When fear and doubt,
Come against your life,
And your faith has been solely tried;
Just lift up your eyes,
And receive your health,
It's Jesus for you, He had died.

Chorus

Rise and be healed in the Name of Jesus,
Let faith abide in your soul,
Rise and be healed in the Name of Jesus,
He will cleanse and make you whole.

If by faith you reach out to Him,
He will meet your every need,
He'll respond to the cry of your heart,
He will touch you and set you free.

title: BE NOT AFRAID
lyrics:
In a ship, on the Sea of Galilee,
There was storm, the disciples wondered, "Where is He?"
Satan swore, he'd get them while Jesus was away,
But in the fourth watch He came,
And said, "Be not afraid!"

Chorus

It is I, be not afraid,
It is I, the way's already made
So don't fear that angry waves
It is I, be not afraid

So here we are being tossed on life's troubled sea,
So alone it makes me wonder, "Where is He?"
Satan says, I won't make it, that I can't find the way,
But then the Lord comes, with these same words,
"It is I, be not afraid"

title: TOMORROW MAY BE TOO LATE
lyrics:
Oh! My friend if you're wandering,
Out in darkness, and all hope is gone,
You don't know where to turn,
Repent of all your sins;
Believe what God has given,
Trust in Jesus, He is the Light,
He'll see you through.

Chorus

For tomorrow may be too late,
And you'll be in sorrow,
Please make (all) things right,
Before the day is through;
And you don't know if the sun,
Will rise tomorrow,Oh! My friend,
It's late to be living now in sin.

Would you bear the reproach,
This Endtime Word is bringing,
Would you gladly receive,
The persecution that will come;
For Jesus said, " You'll be hated,
For My Name sake",
And the time is at hand,
When He's coming back again.

title: WHO AM I?
lyrics:
When I think of how He came, so far from Glory,
He came to dwell among the lowly such as I,
To suffer shame and such disgrace,
On Mount Calvary took my place,
Then I ask myself this question, "Who am I?"

Chorus

Who am I that the King,
Would bleed and die for?
Who am I that He would pray,
"Not My will, Thine Lord!?"
The answer I may never know;
Why He ever loved me so,
That to an old rugged Cross
He'd go for, Who am I?

When I'm reminded of His words,
" I'll leave you never, If you'll be true,
I'll give to you a life forever";
I wonder what I could have done,
To deserve God's only Son,
To fight my battle until they're won, who am I?

title: WE'LL HAVE JOY OVER THERE
lyrics:
There's a longing here below,
Only God's people who can know,
To be changed in a moment,
In the Rapture catch away;
We are looking for a city,
That Abraham did in his day,
I am longing for the Bride to be with Him.

Chorus

We'll have joy over there,
In that City bright and fair,
When we gather around to sing, "Amazing grace";
We will shout then so loud,
And we'll sing of mystery love,
Yes! We'll sing of mystery love over there.

He will call me up there,
Before I climb the golden stair,
We have loved-ones up there waiting,
We'll meet them at the Eastern gate;
Oh! My brother let’s press on,
Till the battles have been won,
I can hardly wait to see my Saviour's face.

title: DON'T PUT OFF TILL TOMORROW
lyrics:
The leaves are falling harvest time is past,
So get in the Spirit the end is coming fast,
The time will soon be here,
When Jesus Christ will come,
Oh! Lift up your head, your redemption,
Is drawing nigh.

Chorus

And it will be too late, my brother then to pray,
Don't put off till tomorrow,
What you can do today,
(For) you'll find yourself in judgement,
Then you'll have to pay,
For the opportunity that had come your way.

Now its gleaning time,
The reapers are in the field,
To find, the last of the seed;
The others will not yield,
And the glory of God will shine,
For its evening time;
And the true Bride of Christ,
Will soon fall into line.

title: A SONG HOLY ANGELS CANNOT SING
lyrics:
Angels never knew a joy that is mine,
For the Blood has never washed, their sins away,
Though they sing in heaven, there will come a time,
When silently they'll listen,
While I sing "Amazing Grace".

Chorus

And it's a song holy angels cannot sing,
"Amazing grace... "How sweet the sound"
It's a song holy angels cannot sing,
"I once was lost... "But now I'm found".

"Holy is the Lord", the angels sing,
Before the throne of God, continually,
For me to join their song, will be a natural thing,
But they just won't know,
The words... to "Love lifted me".

title: TEARS ARE THE LANGUAGE
lyrics:
Often you wonder why, tears come into your eyes,
And burdens seem to be, much more than you can bear;
But God is standing near, He sees your falling tears,
And tears are the language God understands.

Chorus

God sees the tears of a broken-hearted soul
He sees the tears and hears them when they fall,
God weeps along with man and He takes him by the hand,
Tears are the language God understands.

When grief has left you low, it causes tears to flow,
When things have not turned out, the way that you had planned;
But God won't forget you, His promises are true,
Tears are the language God understands.

title: I'M NEARER HOME
lyrics:
I walk with God, through all the years,
Through flame and flood,
Through pain and tears;
I'll follow Him, God's Voice obey,
I'm nearer home than I was yesterday.

Chorus

I'm nearer home than I was yesterday,
I'll walk with my Lord, all along the way,
Each step I take, each prayer I pray,
I'm nearer home than I was yesterday.

Each thought I think, each breath I take,
Each step I walk brings me, nearer heaven's gate,
I'll shout and rejoice, when I'm caught away,
I'm nearer home than I was yesterday.

The fleeting clouds, that swift the sky
The whispering waves that shift then die,
The drifting sands all speak a claim,
You're nearer home than you were yesterday.

title: STATURE OF A PERFECT MAN
lyrics:
As the time is drawing near,
That our Lord will soon appear,
May we check out our lives,
Keep them pure and spotless white,
Daily striving to be, more and more just like Thee,
Getting rid of the small things we find,
Those little foxes that spoils the vine,
Lord! We're asking, we're praying, help us become,
That "STATURE OF A PERFECT MAN"

We need FAITH dear Lord,
It comes by hearing Your WORD;
Next is VIRTUE, strength and power,
To give to others in this evil hour.
KNOWLEDGE to judge the right from wrong
TEMPERANCE to handle our temper and tongue
PATIENCE to wait till God's own time
GODLINESS like You we want to be found
BROTHERLY KINDNESS, Lord help us apply it all.
Then co-mes Your perfect LOVE

Love suffereth long, love protects,
When a brother is wrong,
Love's not eas-ily pro-voked,
When evil about you is spoken,
Love is patient, and kind to all,
Love reaches out when someone falls;
Love covers a multitude of sin,
And Love will make us this battle win,
Lord! We're asking, we're praying, help us become,
That "STATURE OF A PERFECT MAN"

title: A FULL REDEMPTION
lyrics:
We have heard mother eagle's cry
We will fly above the things of this world
For His word is made life in us
In this end time bride

Chorus

We have received a full redemption
From a life of sin, in this evil age,
The Lord has descended in this day,
The Word is made plain (The Word is restored),
We'll never be lost again.

title: SORRY I NEVER KNEW YOU
lyrics:
Last night as I was sleeping, a dream came to me,
I dreamed a-bout the end of time, about eternity;
I saw a million sinners fall on their face to pray,
The Saviour sadly shook His head and this I heard Him say.

REFRAIN:
Sorry I never knew you, Depart from me forevermore,
Sorry I never knew you go and serve
The one that you had served before.

I thot' the time had fully come, when I must stand my trials,
I told the Lord that I'd been a Christian all the while;
But through the books, He then looked,
And sadly shook His head, then He placed,
Me over on His left and this is what He said.

REFRAIN:
Sorry I never knew you, I find no record of your birth,
Sorry I never knew you, go and serve
The one you served while on the earth.

There was my wife and children, I heard each one's voice,
They must have all been happy, It seemed they did rejoice,
With robes of white around them and crown upon their heads,
My little girl looked up at me and this is what she said.

REFRAIN:
Daddy we can't go with you,
We must dwell in the joys of our Lord, on this lovely shore,
Sorry for we still love you,
But you cannot be our Daddy anymore.

When I from sleep awakened with tears in my eyes,
I looked all around about me and to my great surprise,
I saw my wife and babies and I knew I had a dream,
Then down beside my bed I fell and for mercy did scream.

REFRAIN:
Father! Who art in Glory,
In mercy look on me today;
Forgive me and let me serve You,
Till the summon comes and calls me away.

title: HE CARES, DO YOU CARE?
lyrics:
A sinner's cry has always reached the Saviour,
A desperate soul can touch the heart of God,
A fervent (sincere) pray'r, will always be answered,
If you really need the Lord, you'll find He cares for you,
He cares! Do you?

Chorus

He cares! Do you care?
He proved how much He loved you
When He died for you:
Every stripe that He bore was for you,
Just to know what He went through
Proves He cares for you.

When you're down and out, you feel that you're all alone,
Everything you try fails and all hope seems gone,
And you don't have any one you can turn to,
Cast all your cares on Him for He cares for you,
He cares! Do you?

title: HE LOOKED BEYOND
lyrics:
Amazing Grace shall always be my song of praise,
For it was Grace that brought me liberty,
I do not know just why He came to love me so,
He looked beyond my faults and saw my needs.

Chorus

I shall forever lift my eyes to Calvary,
And view the Cross where Jesus died for me;
How marvellous, His grace that caught my falling soul,
He looked beyond my faults and saw my needs.

Until you know the loving hand that reached your soul,
And picked you up above, the plane that you had trod,
To place you where you'd stretch and look the valley low,
Come face to face with God's own sovereign grace.

title: HE COULD HAVE CALLED
lyrics:
They bound the hands of Jesus,
In the garden where He prayed,
They led Him thro' the street in shame;
They spat upon the Saviour,
So pure and free from sin,
They said “Crucify Him” He's to blame.

Chorus

He could have called ten thousand angels,
To destroy the world and set Him free,
He could have called ten thousand angels,
But He died alone, (alone) for you and me.
(for you and me)

Upon His precious head,
They placed a crown of thorns,
They laughed and said "Behold the King";
They struck Him and cursed Him,
And mocked His Holy Name,
And all alone He suffered everything.

When they nailed Him to the Cross,
His mother stood near by,
He said, "Woman, behold thy son";
He cried "I thirst for water",
But they gave Him none to drink,
Then the sinful work of man was done.

To the howling mob He yielded,
He did not for mercy cry,
The Cross of shame He took alone;
And when He cried "It is finished" ,
He gave Himself to die,
Salvation wondrous plan was done.

title: NEVER GET WEARY YET
lyrics:
I never get weary yet,
I never get weary yet,
I never get weary serving (praising) the Lord,
I never get weary yet.

I feel like praising Him,
I feel like praising Him,
I feel like praising God of Branham,
I feel like praising Him.

title: ELSHADDAI
lyrics:
Through Your love and through the ram,
You saved the Sons of Abraham,
Through the power of Your hand;
You turned the sea into dry land,
To the outcast on their knees,
You were the God who really sees,
By Your might, You set Your children free.

Chorus

Elshaddai (2x)
Elyo yona Adonai,
Age to age, You’re still the same
By the power of the Name,
El-shaddai (2x)
El-kon kana Adonai,
I will praise and lift You high,
Elshaddai.

Through the years You made it clear,
That the time of Christ was near,
And though the people couldn't see;
What Messiah ought to be,
Your most awesome work was done,
Through the frailty of Your Son,
I will praise and lift You high, Elshaddai.

title: SWEETER
lyrics:
The more I love Him,
The more I trust Him,
Nothing good from me He'll deny;
The longer I know Him,
With Him I am growing,
And never more from Him to depart.

Chorus

It gets sweeter as the days go by,
It gets sweeter as the moments fly,
His love is sweeter, deeper, fuller;
Sweeter, sweeter, sweeter,
Sweeeter as the days go by.

The moment He saved me
His good grace He gave me
He placed this love deep down in my soul
The longer I know Him
The better I could show it
I couldn't stop now if I try.

title: JUSTIFIED
lyrics:
I was sitting alone and wondering,
About what I’m supposed to do,
Can’t deny the times I made mistakes;
I can’t hide from Him, He knew,
But I knew that deep within my soul,
I felt sorry, honest I do,
So I just cried and said "Forgive me Lord,
Forgive me again", will You?

CHORUS:
Justified (2x), you have not done it,
In the first place you’re justified,
Justified (2x), you have not done it,
In the first place you’re justified

So often, I’m discouraged,
When I count the times I fall,
'Cause He promised I’d be victorious;
When I know I’m not at all,
Then I heard an eagle scream,
His voice quickened my soul;
He said you’ve not done it,
In the first place, you’re justified.

He looks at your perfect picture,
Without blame, spot or wrinkle,
He didn’t look at you from where you’re now;
He looked from Eternity, He said,
"You’re just trapped in that body,
You by-passed your Theophany",
You have not done it,
In the first place, you’re justified.

title: HE ALONE IS WORTHY
lyrics:
He alone is worthy to worship and adore,
The Lamb of God victorious, My Risen Lord,
He purchased my redemption;
My righteousness is He,
Exalt the Name of Jesus,
He is worthy.

title: IT'S A CHALLENGE
lyrics:
It’s a challenge to accept,
It’s a faith to rise into,
It’s a way, I can show the world;
That Jesus Christ is true,
It’s a life to live, a testimony blameless,
Living for Christ, standing e-very test.

CHORUS:
For I’ve got to prove,
I'm one in a million (one in a million),
I've got to show,
The power of the blood (power of the blood);
I've got to prove, I'm not like those,
From Satan’s Eden,
I've got to show that I'm a person,
That this world isn’t worthy of.

True representative of Christ,
In the field that you’ve been placed,
The joy of your life with Him,
Always glowing on your face;
Living humbly, following,
The way He showed,
A true witness of Christ, in this age.

We're the ones that’s going to stand,
And keep the testimony clean,
In the midst of an unbelieving world,
We'll keep looking to the unseen;
To really know, that we will overcome,
And receive His promise,
To sit on His throne.

title: JESUS I JUST WANT TO THANK YOU
lyrics:
Jesus I just want to thank You,
Jesus I just want to thank You,
Jesus I just want to thank You,
I love You for being so good

Chorus

You died for me, You set me free,
You saved my soul,
And You made me whole;
You gave me joy,
Like You said You would,
I love You for being so good.

title: WE ALL SHALL MEET IN HEAVEN
lyrics:
How sweet the hour of praise and prayer,
When our devotions blend,
And on the wings of faith divine,
Our songs of joy ascend!
‘Tis then we hear in tones more clear;
The gracious promise giv'n,
That, though we part from friends on earth,
We all shall meet in heav'n.

Chorus

We all shall meet in heav'n at last,
We all shall meet in heav'n;
Through faith in Jesus’ precious blood,
We all shall meet in heav'n.

How sweet the tie of hallowed love,
That binds our hearts in one,
When gathered in the blessed Name;
Of Christ, the Father’s Son!
And though the parting soon may come,
Yet in His Word is giv'n,
The blessed hope that by and by,
We all shall meet in heav'n.

Yes, soon our worn and weary feet,
Will reach the golden strand,
Where those we love our coming wait,
In yonder summer land;
A few more days, a few more years,
By storm and tempest driv'n,
With songs and everlasting joy,
We all shall meet in heav'n.

title: WE ARE MERCY
lyrics:
We are “MERCY”, We are “GRACE”
We‘re the Living Word of the Hour,
We have the Rapturing Faith.

We have been redeemed,
By the Blood of the Holy Lamb,
And we‘re marching onward to Zion,
To reign with the Great I AM.

We are the Bride of Christ,
Representing HIM on the earth,
We are predestinated for adoption,
By a glorious rebirth.

title: PALMS OF VICTORY
lyrics:
I saw a way-worn traveller,
In tattered garments clad,
And struggling up the mountain,
It seemed that he was sad;
His back was laden – heavy,
His strength was almost gone,
Yet he shouted as he journeyed,
“Deliverance will come.”

Chorus

Then palms of victory,
Crowns of glory,
Palms of victory I shall bear.

The summer sun was shining,
The sweat was on his brow,
His garment worn and dusty,
His steps seemed very slow;
But he kept pressing onward,
For he was going home,
Still shouting as he journeyed,
“Deliverance will come.”

I saw him in the evening,
The sun was bending low,
He’d overtopped the mountain,
And he reached the vale below;
He saw that Golden City,
His everlasting home,
And he shouted loud, “Hosanna,”
"Deliverance has come."

title: THE LOVE OF JESUS IS SO WONDERFUL
lyrics:
The Love of Jesus is so wonderful (3x)
O! Wonderful love.

It's so high, you can’t get over it,
So deep, you can’t get under it;
So wide, you can’t get around it,
O! Wonderful love.

title: EVERYDAY EVERY HOUR
lyrics:
Every day, every hour,
You are faithful oh! Lord. (Repeat)

title: PRESS ON
lyrics:
When the valley is deep,
When the mountain is steep,
When the body is weary;
When we stumble and fall,
When the choices are hard,
When we're battered and scarred;
When we’ve spent our resources,
When we’ve given our all

Chorus

In Jesus Name we press on, (2x)
Dear Lord, till the price,
Clear before our eyes,
We find the strength to press on.

We have heard from our Lord,
The call of Malachi Four,
Our hearts are rejoicing;
For what He has in store,
We are lonely for home,
To see the saints who’ve gone on;
To be changed in a moment,
And walk through heaven’s door.

title: HE'S READY TO COME
lyrics:
I've seen all this world I want to see,
Things I'm hearing got no change on me,
I'm not worried about the future because I know,
He's a ready to come, and I'm ready to go.

Chorus

Things I care about is talking about heaven,
If you wanna go along, you'd better be a believer,
I got a feeling, someday soon we'll be leaving;
And if you wanna ride this train, you'd better not be slow,
He's a ready to come, are you ready to go?
He's a ready to come, are you ready to go?

Sometimes it seems that,
Everything goes wrong,
I just, set around and cry,
And sing old sad songs;
And then He whispers in my ears,
And lets me know,
He's a ready to come, and I'm ready to go.

title: O! BEAUTIFUL STAR
lyrics:
O! Beautiful star of Bethlehem,
Shining our path, thro shadows dim,
Giving the light, for those;
Who long have gone,
Guiding the wise men on their way,
Unto that place where Jesus laid,
Beautiful Star of Bethlehem,
Shine on

Chorus

O! Beautiful Star (Beautiful beautiful star)
Of Bethlehem (of Bethlehem)
Shine upon us, until the Glory door,
Give us a light to guide our way
Unto a land of perfect day,
O! Beautiful Star of Bethlehem
Shine on

O! Beautiful star the hope of rest
For the redeemed, the good and blessed,
Beyond there in Glory
When the crown is won
Jesus is now that Star Divine
Brighter and brighter He will shine
O! Beautiful Star of Bethlehem
Shine on.

title: SURELY THE PRESENCE OF THE LORD
lyrics:
Surely the presence of the Lord, Is in this place,
I can feel His Mighty power and His Gr-a-ce,
I can feel the rush of Angel wings,
I see glory on each face,
Surely the presence of the Lord, is in this place.

title: LORD PREPARE ME
lyrics:
Lord prepare me, to be a sanctuary,
Pure and holy, tried and true,
With thanksgiving, I’ll be a living,
Sanc-tua-ry for You.

title: LORD WITHOUT YOU
lyrics:
Lord, without You, I couldn’t face each morning,
And without You, I couldn’t sleep in peace each night,
Lord, without You, I couldn’t go on another moment, Oh! no,
There’s no use going on, Without You by my side.

Chorus

’Cause Lord You are everything to me,
Yes! Lord You are everything to me,
I love You more than anything,
You are everything to me.

Like a desert, in need of water,
Like a sailor, in need of a sea,
Like a story, in need of an author, Oh! Lord,
Lord, I, need You always by my side.

title: I’M A CHILD OF THE KING
lyrics:
Once I was clothed in the rags of my sin,
Wretched, and poor, lost and lonely within,
But with wondrous compassion;
The King of all kings,
In pity and love, took me under His wings.

Chorus

Oh! Yes, oh! yes, I’m a child of the King,
His royal blood, now flows in my veins,
And I who was wretched and vile,
Now can say, praise God, praise God,
I’m a child of the King.

Now I’m a child, with a heavenly home,
My Heavenly Father has made me His own,
And I’m cleansed, by His blood,
And I’m clothed in His love,
And someday, I’ll sing,
With the angels above.

title: I'M A PRISONER
lyrics:
I could be adrift on life ocean,
And I could be in darkness of sin,
Yes! I could be in such a life sinning,
I could be lost but thank God, I am saved.

Chorus

But now I am free, from sin and shame,
I’m walking in the light of the word of God,
No longer in darkness and no more will I stray,
I’m a prisoner to the One,
Who is in my soul.

I’m thankful that I am a prisoner,
Yes I’m so glad, that Jesus took me in,
Let me never spurn my calling,
And when time is over, let eternity come in.

title: LILY OF THE VALLEY
lyrics:
Lily of the Valley,
Let Your sweet aroma fill my life,
Rose of Sharon show me,
How to grow in beauty in God's sight;
Fairest of Ten Thousand,
Make me a reflection of Your light,
And Day Star shine down on me,
Let Your light shine through me in the night

Chorus

Lead me Lord, I’ll follow,
Anywhere You open up the door,
Let Your Word speak to me;
Show me what I’ve never seen before,
Lord! I want to be a witness,
You can take what’s wrong, and make it right;
Day Star shine down on me,
Let Your light shine through me in the night.

Lord! I see Your world that’s dying,
Wounded by the master of deceit,
Groping in the darkness,
Hard to find the years of past defeat;
But then I see You standing near me,
Shining with the passion in Your eyes,
Jesus shine down on me,
Let Your light shine through me in the night.

title: HE IS ALIVE AND WELL
lyrics:
This same Jesus who died, on the Cross crucified,
Is alive, in our hearts today,
Resurrected again, in a body without sin,
Praise God, He’s alive and well.

Chorus

He’s alive and well,
Living in me to tell the world,
That He is the same,
He’s the Same, Yesterday,
Today and Forever,
Jesus is alive and well.

When Jesus ascended,His word,
He committed to us, that we would abide,
And with that to be endued,
When the Holy Ghost comes on you,
Praise God, He’s alive and well.

The promise He gives, to show that He lives,
In those who truly believe,
The works that I do will be done by you,
Praise God, He’s alive and well.

title: THAT'S JUST HIS WAY
lyrics:
He lets me walk down roads of disappointment,
He watches and He knows What’s best for me,
The more I try the better He can mold me;
And change my life completely,
That it may fit His perfect will.

CHORUS:
That’s just His way of telling me He loves me,
It’s a love beyond all human under-stan-ding,
And I won't question trials, that brings me to my knee,
That’s just His way of telling me He loves me.

If I’m successful walking through this valley,
He’ll give me strength, to climb the highest hill,
My greatest strength comes through my darkest trials,
And my greatest joy is knowing that He can trust in me.

title: I BELIEVE HE’S COMING BACK
lyrics:
High up on the mountain, From where He ascended,
The angel of the Lord, declared that it would be,
He said, “Don’t you stand here grieving,
‘Cos this One that you see leaving,
In like manner is coming back, like He said".

Chorus

I believe He’s coming back, like He said,
I believe that the trumpet's gonna sound so loud,
One day, It’ll resurrect the dead,
In the twinkling of an eye,
He’ll split the Eastern sky,
I believe, He’s coming back, like He said.

I believe the time is nearing,
That we’ll soon see His appearing,
O! This could be the hour, this could be the day;
When the Bride from every nation,
She’s gonna lose earthly gravitation,
In the middle of the air, will be caught away.

title: I'M GETTING READY TO LEAVE
lyrics:
To prepare a mansion, Jesus said, " I’ll go,
If it were not true, I would’ve told you so",
Just a little while to linger here below,
I’m getting ready to leave this world.

Chorus

Getting ready to leave this world,
Getting ready for the Gates of Pearl,
Keeping my record right,
Watching both day and night,
I’m getting ready, to leave this world.

Laying up my treasures in that home above,
Trusting, fully trusting in the Savior’s love,
Doing what I can for Heaven's Holy Dove,
I’m getting ready to leave this world.

Trusting in the riches of His Saving Grace,
Thro each earthly trials, I His love can trace,
Sure that up in Heaven, I will find a place,
I’m getting ready to leave this world.

title: HE’LL EITHER BE IN YOUR HEART OR HAND
lyrics:
Meeting them in Pilate’s hall, all the leaders came,
Pilate said. "I found no fault", they screamed "Away with Him",
They placed on Him a purple robe and say "Crucify this man,
Release to us Barabbas, let His blood be on our hands."

Chorus

He’ll either be in your heart, or on your hand,
Once you’ve met the Saviour,
You’ll never be the same again,
You can turn and walk away;
Or you can choose this man,
He’ll either be in your heart,
Or be on your hand.

Jesus said, "He will return,
And things would be the same",
The whole unbelieving crowd,
Would turn Him down again;
So He sends an INDICTMENT,
For crucifying Him a-gain,
They chose their deno-mina-tions,
That was Jesus on their hands.

Here we are in the same crucifixion,
Back in the message people laugh again,
Where the Word is laid across the tomb,
It would happen to the family of God again;
Over and over, they’re denying this Word,
Giving sub-sti-tutes again,
They’re denying the Word;
Made flesh amongst us,
And choosing men’s tradition again.

title: GOD IS GOOD YOU KNOW HE IS
lyrics:
God is good, you know He is,
He’s good all the time,
God is good, Yes! He is,
He’s good all the time;
You can search the whole world over,
No greater friend, you’ll find,
He’s not good just once in a while,
He’s good all the time.

title: I GO TO THE ROCK
lyrics:
Where can I turn, when there’s no one,
I can turn to, who I'm gonna talk to,
When nobody wants to listen,
Who I'm gonna lean on;
When there’s no foundation stable,
I go to the Rock, I know that's able,
I go to the Rock.

Chorus

I go the Rock of my salvation
Go to the stone that the builders rejected,
Run into the mountain,
And the mountain stands by me;
The earth all around me is sinking sand,
On Christ, the Solid Rock I stand,
When I need a shelter, when I need a friend,
I go to the Rock.

Where can I hide,till the storms are all passed over,
Where I'm gonna run to,
When those winds of sorrow threaten;
There’s a ready refuge, in those times of tribulation,
When my soul needs consolation, I go to the Rock.

title: COME WALK WITH ME
lyrics:
Along life's way, I stumble in the darkness,
My blinded eyes had caused my feet to roam,
I met the Lord Who spoke to me so sweetly,
Come walk with Me and I will see you home.

Chorus

Come walk with Me, the way is strait and narrow,
Come walk with Me and you'll never walk alone,
For the road is rough and there are many dangers,
Come walk with Me and I will see you home.

So now I walk with Christ my Blessed Saviour,
I do not fear for I am not alone,
He guides me through this life, with all its sor-rows,
And someday soon, He'll see me safely home.

title: I CALL HIM LORD
lyrics:
And the angels call Him “Jesus”
Born of a virgin, Mary called Him “Jesus”,
But I call Him, “Lord”
Master, Redeemer, Saviour of the world;
Counselor, Prince of Peace, Almighty God,
Jehovah, Provider, King of all kings,
He was Yesterday, He’ll be Tomorrow,
The Beginning and End.

title: HAD IT NOT BEEN
lyrics:
Just suppose, God searched through heaven,
And couldn’t find one willing (worthy) to be,
The Supreme Sacrifice that was needed,
To buy eternal life, for you and me

Chorus

Had it not been for a place, called Mount Calvary,
And had it not been, for the old rugged Cross,
Had it not been, for a man, called Jesus,
Then forever, my soul would be lost.

I’m so glad, He was willing, to drink this bitter cup,
Although He prayed, “Father! Let it pass from Me”,
I’m so glad, He didn’t call Heaven’s Angel,
From my hand, pull the nail, that torment Him.

Had it not been for a place called Mount Sunset,
Had it not been, for those Seven Seals,
Had it not been,for the Seventh Angel,
Then forever, my soul would be lost.

title: I LOVE YOU LORD AND I LIFT MY VOICE
lyrics:
I love You Lord and I lift my voi-ce,
To worship You Oh! My soul rejoice,
Take joy my King in what You hear,
Let it be a sweet, sweet sound in Your ear.

(I exalt Thee (3x) Oh! Lord).

title: THE ANCHOR HOLDS
lyrics:
I have journeyed, through the long, dark night,
Out on the open sea, by faith alone,
Sight unknown and yet His eyes,
Were watching me.

Chorus

The Anchor holds though the ship be battered,
The Anchor holds, though the sails are torn,
I have fallen, down on my knees; as I face the raging sea,
(But) the Anchor holds, inspite of the storm.

I’ve had vision, and I’ve had dreams,
And I’ve even held them in my hands,
I never knew, those dreams could slip right through,
Like they were only grains of sand.

title: HELP ME BE WHAT YOU WILL HAVE ME BE
lyrics:
Give me day by day my daily bread,
As I bow my un-wor-thy head,
I am looking Lord, only to Thee,
Help me be, what You would have me be.

Chorus

Help me be, what You would have me be,
I know its not too much to ask of Thee,
And I’m sure that You would hear my plea,
So help me be what You would have me be

Help me love, when others do me wrong,
If I’m sad, help me sing a happy song,
Help me smile, when trouble's all I see,
Help me be Lord, what You would have me be.

title: IN MY LIFE, LORD
lyrics:
In my life, Lord
Be glorified, be glorified,
In my life, Lord,
Be glorified, today.

title: BURNING THE MIDNIGHT OIL
lyrics:
I told the Lord, I was willing to do,
Just anything, He wanted me to,
He said that I must be willing to toil,
To seek and to pray and burn midnight oil.

Chorus

Burning the midnight oil,
Seeking for peace and for joy,
Praying for souls that are lost,
I’m burning the midnight oil.

Souls in the harvest, that have gone astray,
The reaper is coming and there’s no time to wait,
Satan is warring their soul to destroy,
It’s time we started burning, the midnight oil.

title: WHERE EAGLES DARE
lyrics:
We have been born in an eagle age,
By an Eagle Prophet’s message,
To manifest the Living Word for our day;
We have been given wings to fly,
Way up in the sky, where no other bird can fly;
To live in a heavenly atmosphere,
To fly where only eagles dare.

Chorus

Let’s fly so high,
Where the Word of God is a living reality,
To soar so high, true eagles in the sky,
Set your wings let’s fly, where eagles dare.

We have been gathered by the shout,
A message that called us out,
From this world of fear and doubt;
And we have been given eyes to see,
All the mysteries are being revealed,
Our lives are fulfilling pro-phe-cy;
To see our position in God’s word,
To fly where only eagles could.

title: LOVE IS WHY
lyrics:
He never said, I’ll have silver or gold,
Yet He has promised me, a mansion untold,
He never offered me, a life without care,
Yet He relieves every burden I bear.

Chorus

Sin stained the Cross,
With the blood of my Lord,
Yet He permitted it, without a word,
Why, tell me why, He redeemed you and me,
Love is why you and I are free.

Though I have none of this world’s precious goods,
Yet I’m an heir to all, Heaven's purpose,
Though I may never, achieve worldly fame,
Yet all of Heaven can call me by name.

title: WHERE THE BORN AGAIN STAY
lyrics:
There’s a place, where you can go,
To cry your troubles away,
And it’s found in Jesus Christ,
Where the born again stay.

You may think no one loves you,
There’s not a friend all around,
But I have good news to bring,
News that you won’t regret.

Chorus

Come on into the One called Love,
Joy and peace you will find,
Take your place with Jesus Christ,
For the rest of your day;
Without money, without price,
He’ll take you just as you are,
(If you humbly come today,
Where the born again stay). (2x)

title: LET'S BE READY
lyrics:
In the book of Malachi 4 and 5,
We find that there is a prophet to arrive,
To bring the Bride back to the Word,
From false teachings she has heard,
Let's be ready when the Lord shall come.

Chorus

If you’re ready when the Lord shall come,
You'll go with Him to that Heavenly Home,
All God’s children will be there;
In that home so bright and fair,
If you’re ready when the Lord shall come,

A word to the church He did say,
That she loves one another all the way,
And when one falls in sin,
Reach right down and rescue him,
Let’s be ready when the Lord shall come.

This Prophet of the Lord, has come and gone,
But the message that He brought it still lives on,
And if you’ll let it live in you,
It will safely guide you through,
Let’s be ready when the Lord shall come.

title: CRYING, TRAVAILING
lyrics:
So often, I find myself slipping,
In little things you may think it doesn’t matter,
But when I come into His Ho-ly presence
His Light reveals my life and shows me where, I’m wrong.

Chorus

C-r-y-i-n-g, t-r-a-v-a-i-l-i-n-g,
Oh! Lord, hear our prayers,
C-r-y-i-n-g, t-r-a-v-a-i-l-i-n-g,
Oh! Lord, come take us home.

O! This life on earth, is only a shadow,
And the Bride of Christ is longing for the morning,
When the King of kings, is coming in power,
To see Him face to face,His glory we’ll behold.

title: DON'T QUIT
lyrics:
When things go wrong, as they sometimes will,
And the road you’re travelling seem up a hill,
When the money's low and the debts are high,
And you want to smile but (you) just have to sigh.

Chorus

Don’t quit, don’t quit,
Just stick to the fight, when you’re hardest hit,
Don’t quit, don’t quit,
It’s when things seem worse, that you must not quit.

Don’t give up though the pace, may seem so slow,
Remember God gives you grace, as you go,
A winner never quits and the quitter never wins,
Oh! You can’t go wrong, if you depend on Him.

title: I'LL ALWAYS LOVE HIM
lyrics:
I’ll always remember, the day Jesus found me,
He changed my life through and through,
And now that He saved me, in love, He forgave me,
I fell in love with Him.

Chorus

I’ll always love Him, For the rest of my life,
He is my Saviour, I walk in His light,
We’re always together, And it feels so right,
I’ll always love Him, for the rest of my life.

By predestination in His mind He saw me,
Shouting and praising His Name,
And that’s why I love Him, I praise and adore Him,
He is my life today.

title: ONE DAY AT A TIME
lyrics:
I’m only human, I’m just a man,
Help me believe in what I could be,
And all that I am show me the stair way,
I have to climb, Lord for my sake
Teach me to take, one day at a time.

Chorus

One day at a time, Sweet Jesus,
That’s all I’m asking from You,
Just give me the strength;
To do everyday, what I have to do,
Yesterday’s gone, Sweet Jesus;
And tomorrow may never be mine,
Lord! Help me today, show me the way,
One day at a time.

Do You remember, when You walked among men?
Lord! Jesus You know, If you’re looking below,
It’s worse now than then,
Cheating and stealing, violence and crime;
So for my sake, teach me to take,
One day at a time.

title: IN TIMES OF TROUBLE
lyrics:
In times of troubles, and inward struggle,
When it seems the end of the road,
Taking His direction, I’m longing for perfection,
I only need to feel His hand in mine,

Chorus

Dear Jesus, I’m in Your pavilion,
There I find the strength, I need to carry on,
In the secret of Your presence,
Beholding Your beauty Oh! Lord.

In God’s word I’m reading,
How my life is leading,
Onward to that beautiful shore,
I’ll greet the saints at heaven's door,
With the love I never felt before
What joy is waiting there for me,

Chorus

But until then, I’ll stay in Your pavi-lion,
There I'll find the strength, I need to carry on,
In the secret of Your presence,
Beholding Your beauty Oh! Lord.

title: HIS LOVE HAS NO LIMIT
lyrics:
He giveth more grace,
When the burdens grow greater,
He sendeth more strenght,
When the labours increase.
To added afflic-tion,
He addeth His mercy,
To multi-plied trials,
His multiplied peace.

Chorus

His Love, has no limit,
His Grace, has no measure,
His Power, has no boundary,
Known unto man;
For out of His infinite riches in Jesus,
He giveth and giveth,
And He give-th again.

When we have exhausted,
Our store of endurance,
When our strengths has failed;
'Ere the day is half-done,
When we reach the end;
Of our hoarded resources,
Our Father's full giving is only begun.

title: ANCIENT WORDS
lyrics:
Holy Words long preserved,
For our walk in this world,
They resound with God’s own heart;
O! Let the word of God impart,
Words of life, words of hope,
Give us strength, help us cope;
In this world where we roam,
The Word of God will guide us home

Chorus

Word of God ever true,
Changing me and changing you,
We have come with open hearts,
O! Let the word of God impact.

Holy Words of our Faith,
Handed down to this age,
Came to us through sacrifice,
O! Heed the faithful Words of Christ;
Holy Words long preserved,
For our walk in this world,
They resound with God’s own heart,
O! Let the word of God impart.

title: HE DIDN’T THROW THE CLAY AWAY
lyrics:
Empty and broken, I came back to Him,
A vessel unworthy, so scarred by sin,
But He did not des-pair;
He started o-ver a-gain,
And I bless that day,
He didn’t throw the clay a-way.

Chorus

O-ver and over, He molds me and makes me
Into His likeness, He fashions the clay,
A vessel of honour, I am to-day;
It’s all because Jesus,
Didn’t throw the clay a-way.

He is the Pot-ter, I am the clay.
Mold-ed in His image
He wants me to stay
But when I stumble and I fall;
And my vessel breaks,
He just picks up, those broken pieces,
He doesn’t throw the clay a-way.

title: THE SON SHINES DOWN ON ME
lyrics:
Like a tiny seed held in the ground,
I lay in darkness, unaware of the SON,
Behind the cloud, then the light;
The Light of God shone in my soul,
I was born again, free from my sin,
Free to serve Him.

Chorus

The SON shines down on me,
His Word is changing me,
And making all my darkness flee,
He lives in me (2x);
Since the day I heard His Voice,
And made Him my choice,
I’m living in the presence of the SON.

Into the darkness of this end time hour,
The Evening Light is shinning,
And it’s leading me, to that resurrection day;
Then the shadow of this light, will fade away,
Changed we will be, to immortality eternally.

title: GO TELL IT ON THE MOUNTAIN
lyrics:
While shepherds kept their watching,
O'er si-lent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens,
There shone a Holy light,

Chorus

Go tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere,
Go tell it on the mountain, that Jesus,
Christ is born (Lord).

The shepherds feared and trembled,
When lo! above the earth,
Rang out the Angel chorus,
That hailed our Saviour's birth.

Down in a lowly manger,
The humble Christ was born;
And God sent us salvation,
That blessed Christmas Morn.

title: I’M HEALED, I AM WHOLE
lyrics:
The enemy is always trying to put me down,
Lying every step of the way,
He’s saying that my faith is unsound;
Telling me be careful what you say,
But I believe that I’ve received my health,
That the prayer of faith was prayed for me;
I believe that when I heard Amen,
That to me resounded victory.

Chorus

I am healed I am whole,
From the top of my head to the sole,
To the tip of my toes Isaiah 53:5 (I Peter 2:24);
Says you were and if you are then I am,
I am healed I am whole,
From the top of my head,
To the sole to the tip of my toe.

I hold fast to that which I confess,
Satan’s sin and sickness has to flee,
Cause I’m tired of being sick and tied;
Of wicked powers and principalities,
I praise God for Jesus and the Cross,
Of His finished work on Calvary;
And because He paid the total cost,
I can sing my (a) song of victory.

title: THE HARVEST IS PASSING
lyrics:
Hark, sinner, while God,
From on high doth entreat thee,
And warnings with ac-cents;
Of mercy doth blend,
Give ear to His voice;
Lest in judgment He meets thee;
“The harvest is passing,
The summer will end”.

Chorus

(“The harvest is passing.
The summer will end”) 2x

How oft of thy danger,
And guilt He hath told thee,
How oft still the message,
Of mercy doth send!
Haste, haste, while He waits
In His arms to enfold thee:
“The harvest is passing,
The summer will end”

Des-pised and rejected at length
He may leave thee;
What anguish and horror,
Thy bosom will rend!
Then haste thee, o sinner,
While He will receive thee;
“The harvest is passing,
The summer will end”

The Saviour will call thee,
In judgment before Him,
Oh! Bow to His scepter,
And make Him your friend!
Now yield Him your heart,
And make haste to adore Him,
“The harvest is passing,
The summer will end”

title: BEULAH LAND, I'M LONGING FOR YOU
lyrics:
I’m kind of, home-sick, for a country,
To which I’ve ne-ver been before,
No sad goodbyes, will there be spo-ken,
And time won’t mat-ter, anymore.

Chorus

Beulah land, I’m longing for you,
And someday, on thee I’ll stand,
Where my home shall be eter-nal,
In Beulah land, sweet beulah land.

I’m looking now, across that river,
To where my faith, is gonna end in sight,
There’s just a few more days to labour,
Then I will take, my heavenly flight.

title: ONLY A MATTER OF MERCY
lyrics:
Well, I took sometime,
To look inside of my heart,
I didn’t know what I would find;
And to my surprise the things,
That mattered the most,
Were all at the end of the line;
Well I started listening to the Master’s voice,
It seems that He was speaking to me;
It's only a matter of mercy,
That I’m part of the family.

Chorus

It was only a matter of mercy,
It was only a matter of grace,
Only a matter of His sweet, sweet love;
There's a smile upon my face,
It was only a matter of time before,
The Word took the best out of me;
Only a matter of mercy,
That I’m part of the family.

All that He asked for was all that I had,
So I gave it all back to Him,
And true to His word for what little He took;
He keeps giving and giving again,
Well, He could have made a better investment,
Instead He put His love on me;
And It's only a matter of mercy,
That I’m part of the family.

title: I SHOULD HAVE BEEN CRUCIFIED
lyrics:
I was guilty with nothing to say,
And they were coming, to take me away,
Then a voice from heaven;
Was heard, that said,
Let him go, take Me instead.

Chorus

When I should have been crucified,
I should have suffered and died,
I should have hung on the Cross in His place,
But Jesus, God’s Son, took my place.

The crown of thorns, and a spear in His side,
And all the pain that, should have been mine,
The rusty nails, that were meant for me,
But Jesus took them, and let me go free.

title: GIVE THEM ALL TO JESUS
lyrics:
Are you tired of chasing pretty rainbow,
Are you tired of spinning, round and round,
Wrap up all those shattered dreams;
In your life and, at the feet,
Of Jesus lay them down.

Chorus

Give them all, give them all,
Give them all to Jesus, shattered dreams,
Wounded hearts, broken toys;
Give them all, give them all,
Give them all to Jesus,
And He will turn your sorrow into joy.

He never said, you’d only see sunshine,
He never said, there’d be no rain;
He only promised a heart full of singing,
At the very thing that once brought pains.

title: HE HAS GOT OUR RANSOM PRICE PAID
lyrics:
O! Lamb that bled in my stead,
O! Lamb that died on the Cross,
Our sins were upon Him;
And all our transgressions,
He has got our ransom price paid.

Chorus

He has got our ransom price paid (2x)
And just then I remember when,
He said, “It is finished”,
He has got our ransom price paid.

O! Blood that dripped from His side,
How cruel is the death on the Cross,
He came in our nature;
And felt our afflictions,
He has got our ransom price paid.

What the blood of the bulls couldn’t do,
What the blood of the ox couldn’t do,
Jesus died on Calvary;
When He said, “It is finished”,
He has got our ransom price paid.

title: I KNOW THE MASTER OF THE WIND
lyrics:
My boat of life sails on a trouble sea,
Whenever there’s a wind in my sail,
But I have a friend Who watches over me,
When the breeze turns into a gale.

Chorus

I know the Master of the wind,
I know the Maker of the rain;
He can calm the storm,
Make the sun to shine again,
I know the Master of the wind.

Sometimes I soar like,
An eagle through the sky,
Above the peaks my soul can be found;
An unexpected storm may,
Drive me from the heights,
Brings me low, but never brings me down.

title: UNTIL
lyrics:
When we heard you were coming,
We knew it would be such a blessing,
To meet with friends and family,
Another part of His mystical body;
But now the time, the time has come,
That you would be going home,
We’re not going to say goodbye;
We’re just going to say ‘until’.

Chorus

Until we hear that last Trump sound,
In a moment we’ll all be gone,
Across the Continental Divide,
We’ll meet you over on the other side;
Until that morning breaks,
Eternal bright and fair,
We’ll all be there;
We’re not going to say goodbye,
We’re just going to say ‘until’.

Your coming here has made us stronger,
Wish you could stay a little longer,
For there is so much more,
From your Ministry that we could draw;
Seeing that you have to leave,
Come again we’re asking, please;
So we’re not going to say goodbye,
We’re just going to say ‘until’.

title: THOU THINKEST, LORD OF ME
lyrics:
Amid the trials that I meet,
Amid the thorns that pierce my feet,
One thought remain supremely sweet,
Thou thinkest, Lord of me!

Chorus

Thou thinkest Lord of me!
Thou thinkest Lord of me!
What need I fear when Thou art near,
And thinkest, Lord of me.

The cares of life come thronging fast,
Up-on my soul their shad-dows cast;
Their gloom reminds my heart at last,
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me.

Let shadows come, let shadows go,
Let life be bright, or dark with woe,
I am content; for this I know,
Thou thinkest, Lord, of me.

title: GOD IS ONLY A PRAYER AWAY
lyrics:
Troubles may come and troubles may go,
We never know what we’ll face,
But God is right there, to answer our plea,
He’s just a prayer away.

Chorus

God is only a prayer away,
He will hear you, if you just pray,
No matter whatever may come today,
God is only a prayer away.

There have been times,
In my life down here,
That I didn’t know what to do;
Then something inside,
Would whisper and say,
He’s just a prayer away.

title: WE ARE GRATEFUL OH GOD
lyrics:
We are grateful Oh! God (2x)
For all You have done for us, Halleluyah!
We are grateful Oh! God.

title: SUCH WONDERFUL LOVE
lyrics:
On the right road I’ve travelled,
Since Jesus came in,
Took away all my sins;
He gladly bore the shame,
When they nailed Him to the Cross,
He never counted the cost;
Praise the Lord! Hallelujah!
Oh! The love He had for us.

Chorus

Such love, such wonderful love,
I was lost, condemned to die,
When He reached down His hand for me,
He took my place at Calvary.

When they stood all around Him,
And accused Him of sin,
They mocked Him and smote Him,
And cursed His Holy Name;
Yet He stood there like a lamb,
Not one word to defend,
Praise the Lord! Halleluyah!
All glory to the Lamb.

title: GONE!
lyrics:
Mary came unto the tomb of Jesus,
The stone had moved
The Lord had gone away,
The Angel said, “Fear not,
I know Who seek ye,
But He is risen,”
This she heard him say.

Chorus

Gone! The stone's been rolled back,
Gone! The tomb is empty,
Gone! To sit at the Father’s side;
Gone! Over death triumphant,
Gone! Sin is defeated,
Gone! He lives forever more.

My friend, if you don’t know,
This risen Saviour,
I beg of you, don’t wait too late to pray;
Don’t wait until His Bride,
Has been completed,
Don’t wait until you hear,
Him say, “Too late”.

title: THE PEACE OF GOD
lyrics:
There’s a peace to know,
That you are saved,
And that all your sins are washed away;
But then there’s a peace,
That passeth all understanding,
A peace that cannot easily be disturbed.

Chorus

For it’s good to know you’re justified,
Your sins are under the blood;
It’s good to know you cannot be lost,
Under no cir-cum-stance,
But when the perils of this life,
Befalls you everyday;
There’s peace with God,
But most of all you need,
The peace of God.

The Father comes and shows,
You where you are standing,
And that your sins were placed;
In the Sea of Forgetfulness,
But sight and time being;
Your worst enemies,
Breed fear and sometimes insecurity.

title: GUIDE ME
lyrics:
Guide me, O! Thou Great Jeho-vah,
Pilgrim thro’ this barren land;
I am weak but Thou art mighty;
Hold me with Thy powerful hand,
Bread of heaven, bread of heaven,
Feed me till I want no more.

O-pen now the crystal fountain,
Whence the healing waters flow;
Let the fiery, cloudy pil-lar,
Lead me all my journey through;
Strong Deliverer, strong Deliverer,
Be Thou still my strength and shield.

When I tread the verge of Jordan,
Bid my anxious fears subside,
Bear me thro’ the swelling current,
Land me safe on Canaan’s side,
Songs of praises, songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee.

title: THE BLOOD WILL NEVER LOSE ITS POWER
lyrics:
The blood that Jesus shed for me,
Way back on Calvary,
The blood that gives me;
Strength from day to day,
It will never lose its power.

Chorus

For it reaches to the highest mountain,
And it flows to the lowest valley;
The blood that gives me strength,
From day to day,
It will never lose its power.

It soothes my doubts
And calms my fears,
And it dries all my tears,
The blood that gives me;
Strength from day to day,
It will never lose its power.

title: ON THE RESURRECTION MORNING
lyrics:
On the resurrection morning,
Soul and body meet again,
No more sorrow, no more weeping,
No more pain.

Here awhile they must be parted,
And the flesh its Sabbath keep;
Waiting in a holy stillness,
Wrapped in sleep.

For a space the tired body,
Waits in peace the morning dawn,
When there breaks the last,
And brightest Easter morn.

On that happy Easter morning,
All the graves their dead restore,
Father, sister, child and mother,
Meet once more.

Soul and body, reunited,
Thenceforth nothing shall divide;
Walking up in Christ’s own likeness;
Satisfied.

title: JEHOVAH JIREH
GOD’S FAMILY
lyrics:
We’re part of the family,
That’s been borned again,
Part of a family whose,
Love knows no end;
For Jesus has saved us,
And made us His own,
Now we’re part of the family,
That’s on It’s way home.

Chorus

Sometimes we laugh together,
Sometimes we cry,
And sometimes we have together,
Heartaches and sighs;
Sometimes we dream together,
Of how it will be,
When we all get to heaven,
God’s family.

When a brother is in sorrow,
We all feel his grief,
When he passes through the valley,
We all be with him;
Together in sunshine, together in rain,
Together in victory,
Through His precious blood.

And though some go before us,
We’ll all meet again,
Just inside that City,
As we’re journeying on;
There’ll be no more parting,
With Jesus we’ll be,
Together forever, God’s family.

title: I LOVE YOU
lyrics:
In letters of crimson,
God wrote His love,
On a hillside so long, long ago;
For you and for me, Jesus died,
And love's greatest story was wrote.

Chorus

I love you (2x)
That’s what Calvary said,
I love you (3x), written in red.

Down through the ages,
God wrote His love,
With the same hands;
That suffered and bled,
Giving all, that He had to give,
A message so easi-ly read.

title: YOU’RE MY ABSOLUTE
lyrics:
I wandered around from pillar to post,
Searching for strength and stability,
Neglecting the thing that I needed most,
A solid foundation of Christ in me

Crying, I poured out my heart to You, Lord,
You gave me assurance,You gave me a sword,
Now there’s no question, there’s no doubt,
I know that I know what You’re all about

Chorus

You’re my Absolute,
You’re my Strong and Mighty hold,
You’re the Rock through all the ages;
You’re the One I now behold,
You’re my Absolute,
I place my life into Your hands;
And I know that You will lead me,
Safely to the promise land.

Never before have I felt such love,
Never before have I seen Your power,
A life changing work You have done in my life,
Transforming my very heart’s desire.

You are my Saviour, Redeemer and Friend,
I’ll never turn back to this world again,
Abundance of mercy and grace You bestow,
There’s one thing I want this whole world to know.

title: WHEN GOD DIPPED HIS LOVE IN MY HEART
lyrics:
When God dipped His pen,
Of love in my heart,
And wrote my soul a message;
He wants me to know,
His Spirit, all divine,
Fills this sinful soul of mine,
When God dipped His love in my heart.

Chorus

Well! I said I wouldn’t tell,
It to a living soul,
How He brought salvation;
When He made me whole,
But I found I couldn’t hide,
Such love as Jesus did impart;
It makes me laugh and it makes me cry,
Set my sinful soul on fire,
When God dipped His love in my heart.

Sometimes though the road,
Is dreary, dark and cold,
And some unburdened sorrow,
Keeps me from the goal;
I go to God in prayer,
I can always find Him there,
To whisper sweet peace to my soul.

title: HARK MY SOUL!
lyrics:
Hark my soul! It is the Lord,
Tis thy Saviour hear His word,
Jes-us speaks, and speaks to thee,
Say, poor sinner, lov’st thou me?

I delivered thee when bound,
And when bleeding, healed thy wound,
Sought thee wondering, set thee right;
Turned thy darkness into light.

Can a woman’s tender care,
Cease towards the child she bare?
Yes, she may forgetful be;
Yet will I remember thee.

Mine is an unchanging love,
Higher than the heights above;
Deeper than the depths beneath,
Free and faithful, strong as death.

title: YIELD NOT TO TEMPTATION
lyrics:
Yield not to temptation,
For yielding is sin,
Each vic-tory will help you,
Some other to win;
Fight man-ful-ly onward,
Dark passions sub-due;
Look ever to Jesus,
He’ll carry you through.

Chorus

Ask Jesus to help you,
Comfort, strengthen and keep you;
He is willing to aid you,
He will carry you through.

Shun e-vil com-panions
Bad language dis-dain;
God’s Name hold in reverence,
Nor take it in vain
Be thoughtful and earnest,
Kind-hearted and true;
Look ever to Jesus,
He’ll carry you through.

To him that o’er cometh,
God giveth a crown;
Thro’ faith we will conquer
Though often cast down;
He Who is our Saviour,
Our strength will re-new;
Look e-ver to Jesus,
He’ll carry you through.

title: HE'S GOT IT ALL IN CONTROL
lyrics:
He's got it all in control (2x)
He's put that reassurance,
Way down in my soul,
He's got it all in control.

I've put my life in His hands (2x)
So every road I walk down,
I'm sure is in His hands,
I've put my life in His hand.

My Father knows what I need (2x)
In everything I go through,
He knows what’s best for me,
My Father knows what I need.

title: I TALK WITH THE KING
lyrics:
The president, don’t know me,
The governor's not heard of me,
The mayor of our town,
Has never heard my name;
Doctors don’t speak to me,
Lawyers walk right by me,
In the Spirit where It really counts,
I talk with the King.

Chorus

I talk with the King, I'm a friend of Royalty,
I talk with the King, all heaven knows my na-me,
There’s not a country in this world, a kingdom or domain
Where the people bow their heads in prayer,
And talk with their King.

I’ve sung a Gospel song,
Almost all my life,
You don't find my picture,
On the bill board;
Or see my name in lines,
Never wrote a hit song,
Being seen in news magazines;
But look what Jesus did for me,
I sing to His Queen.

title: HIS PRESENCE
lyrics:
How sweet it is to walk in His presence,
And feel His Mighty hands on me,
Always protecting, always providing,
Always making, a way for me.

Chorus

Protector, Provider is Jesus,
He’s been so good to me,
And when I come to the end of the way,
His presence will be there that day.

A man when he thinks,
That God is not looking,
Will curse, lust, lie, cheat and steal,
But bring him into,
The presence of Jehovah,
His life will change,
And he’ll be born anew.

title: THANK YOU
lyrics:
I dreamed I went to heaven,
And you were there with me,
We walked upon the Streets of Gold;
Beside the Crystal Sea,
Heard the angels singing,
Someone called your name;
You turned and saw this young man;
And he was smiling as he came.

And he said, “Friend,
You may not know me now"
Then he said, "but wait,
You used to teach my Sunday School!
When I was only eight",
Every week you would say a prayer;
Before the class would start,
One day when you said that prayer,
I asked Jesus in my heart.

Chorus

Thank you for giving to the Lord,
I am a life that was chan-ged,
Thank you for giving to the Lord,
I am so glad you gave.

Then another man stood before you,
He said "Remember the time,
A missionary came to your church,
His picture made you cry;
You didn’t have much money,
But you gave it any way",
Jesus took the gift you gave,
And that’s why I’m heaven today.

One by one they came,
As far as your eyes could see,
Each life some how touched;
By your gene-ro-sity,
Little things that you had done,
Sa-cri-fices you made;
They were unnoticed on the earth,
But in heaven now proclaims.

title: SOMETHING BEAUTIFUL
lyrics:
Something beautiful, something good,
All my confusion He understood,
All I had to offer Him;
Was brokenness and strife,
But He made something,
Beautiful of my life.

title: LORD I LOVE YOU
lyrics:
I’ve never been able to say,
Things like I wanted to,
To explain just how I feel;
Is hard for me to do,
If I could only pour out,
My heart to You, Lord!
The whole world will know,
I love You.

Chorus

Lord! I love You, I want to serve You,
You’ve been so good to me,
You’ve met my every need;
Oh! The grace You’ve shown,
Greater love I never know,
Lord! I love You.

When the summons comes,
I'm called away to be with You,
Just to realize I’ve made it,
Your grace has brought me through;
When I walk down the corridors of Glory,
Stand face to face with You,
All of heaven will hear me shouting,
Lord I love You.

title: HE DIDN'T HAVE TO DO IT, BUT HE DID
lyrics:
He didn’t have to do it, but He did (2x)
He woke me up this morning,
He started me on my way,
He didn’t have to do it, but He did.

Chorus

The Lord has been so good to me (2x)
He woke me up this morning,
He started me on my way,
He didn’t have to do it, but He did.

He didn’t have to save me, but He did (2x)
He woke me up this morning,
He started me on my way,
He didn’t have to do it, but He did.

He didn't have to send the prophet, but He did (2x)
He received the Seven Seals Message,
And he got that Super Anointing,
He didn’t have to do it, but He did.

title: THE OLD-FASHIONED MEETING
lyrics:
O! How well I remember,
In the old-fashioned days,
When some old-fashioned people;
Had some old-fashioned ways,
In the old-fashioned meetings,
As they tarried there;
In the old-fashioned manner,
How God answered their pray’rs.

Chorus

T’ was an old-fashioned meeting,
In an old-fashioned place,
Where some old-fashioned people,
Had some old-fashion grace;
As an old-fashioned sin-ner,
I began to pray, and God heard me,
And saved me in the old-fashioned way.

There was sing-ging, such singing,
Of those old-fashioned airs,
There was power, such power,
In those old-fashioned pray'rs!
And old-fashioned conviction;
Made the sinner pray,
And the Lord heard and saved him,
In an old-fashioned way.

Well, they say it is better,
“Things have changed, don’t you know,”
And the people in gen’ral,
Seem to think it is so;
And they call me old-fashioned,
When I dare to say, that I like it,
Far better in the old-fashioned way.

If the Lord never changes,
As the fashions of men,
If He’s always the same, why,
He is old-fashioned then!
As an old-fashioned sinner;
Saved through old time grace,
O! I’m sure He will take me,
To an old-fashioned place.

title: SHATTERED DREAMS
lyrics:
I decided, to leave home and family,
And leave all the love I've known behind,
Never thinking, of the heartaches;
I would encounter,
In search of a dream within my mind,

It didn’t matter, when I left,
Whose heart, was bro-ken,
I didn’t care, how many tears were cried,
I was determined, within my heart;
To have my way now,
And seek for the wilder side of life.

Chorus

Shatter-ed dreams, shatter-ed dreams,
Nothing I planned had turned out right
Shattered dreams, shattered dreams,
My life without Christ is shattered dreams

Headed home now,
I need my father ’s mercy,
For I've sinned and I know;
I've brought dis-grace,
But I will ask Him, to forgive me;
Though unworthy,
I'll be so glad just to see,
The look upon His face

title: OH! WHAT A SAVIOUR
lyrics:
Once I was straying in sin’s dark valley,
No hope with-in could I see,
I searched through heaven;
To find the Saviour,
To save a poor lost soul like me.

Chorus

Oh! What a Saviour,
Oh! Hallelujah, His heart was bro-ken,
On Cal-vary, His hands were nail-scarred,
His heart was riven, He gave,
His last blood for even me

Death's chilly waters, I’ll soon be crossing;
His hands will lead me safely home,
I’ll join the chorus, In that Great City,
And sing up there forever more.

title: GIVE ME A DOUBLE PORTION
lyrics:
Long ago in the days of old,
Stood a man of God we’re told,
As he talked to Elijah that day;
Standing at Elijah’s feet,
“A double portion” I can hear him say.

Chorus

Give me, Lord, a double portion,
Pour Thy spirit on me,
Thru eyes of faith,
Thy wondrous works I can see;
But I need Thy helping hand,
In this troubled, sinful world,
Give me, Lord a double portion from Thee.

As Elijah stood that day,
To Elisha he did say,
“Ask me what I shall do unto thee,”
And Elisha then replied,
Walking at Elijah’s side,
“A double portion, let it fall on me”.

Lord, I always to Thee pray,
Just for strength from day to day,
But I see there’s so much to be done,
That I have to kneel anew,
And this favour ask of You,
A double portion this fight must be won.

title: HIS LIFE FOR MINE
lyrics:
His heart was broken,
Mine was mended,
He became sin now I am clean;
The Cross He carried bore my burdens,
The nails that held Him set me free.

Chorus

His life for mine (2x)
How could it ever be,
That He would die,
God's Son would die;
To save a wretched like me,
What love divine,
He gave His life for mine.

His scars of suffering,
Brought me healing,
He spilled His blood to fill my soul;
His crown of thorns made me royalty,
His sorrow gave me joy untold.

title: I’VE NEVER BEEN SORRY
lyrics:
Ever since Jesus saved and pardoned,
I have been singing every day,
I’ve never been sorry,
That I trusted His Name;
Through the dark shadows,
He is with me,
Leading me on the upward way;
I’ve never been sorry,
That I trusted His Name!

Chorus

I’ve never been sorry (Praise the Lord )
That I trusted His Name (Blessed Holy name)
Every moment I find Him (All the way)
Exactly the same (He’s exactly the same)
My soul's been singing (Every day)
Since the Saviour came (Since the Saviour came)
I’ve never been sorry (Praise the Lord)
That I trusted His Name (Precious, Holy name)

All the day long I sing the story,
Praising Him for His wondrous love,
I’ve never been sorry,
That I trusted His Name,
Surely I know a home is waiting;
Beautiful home in Heav’n above,
I’ve never been sorry,
That I trusted His Name.

Brightly the Star of hope is shining,
Making my pathway brighter grow,
I’ve never been sorry,
That I trusted His Name;
Never a tho’t of sad repining,
Jesus is with me, this I know,
I’ve never been sorry
That I trusted His Name.

title: DO YOU KNOW
lyrics:
Do you know why I believe in Jesus,
Do you know why He’s so real,
At the Seventh Watch;
He sent William Branham (Bro. Bill),
I don’t know where I could have been,
If he didn’t come.

title: HE CANNOT CROSS THE BLOOD
lyrics:
He came to your house,
A Lamb without blemish,
And no power can ever defile;
You’ll be saved from the tempter,
He can do no harm,
If the blood is applied to your heart.

Sins are lost in the sea of His mercy,
Rolled away by the crimson flow,
The destroyers may pass,
At the mid-night hour,
But He cannot cross the blood.

Chorus

He cannot cross the bloodline,
Though his presence so far overflow,
He trembles at the sign of the crimson stain,
And he cannot cross the blood.

If trials you encounter seems endless,
Just remember you’re never alone,
There is Someone who knows
About it, my child, He’ll be there,
When all others are gone

Rest assure He won’t leave nor forsake you,
He has peace, He’s the dear Lamb of God,
There is power to sustain,
When you whisper His Name,
And the tempter turns back at the blood.

title: THE POTTER’S HANDS
lyrics:
Beautiful Lord, Wonderful Saviour,
I know for sure, all of my days,
Are held in Your hands,
Crafted into Your perfect plan.

You gently call me, into Your presence,
Guiding me by, Your Holy Spirit,
Teach me dear Lord,
To live all of my life through Your eyes.

I’m captured by, Your Holy calling,
Set me apart I know,
You’re drawing me to Yourself,
Lead me Lord I pray.

Take me, mould me, use me, fill me,
I give my life to the Potter’s hands,
Call me, guide me, lead me, walk beside me,
I give my life to the Potter’s hands.

title: DO YOU KNOW GRACE
lyrics:
I was down as low as one could go,
I had no strength of my own,
Everything I’d worked for, all my life;
Everything I loved was gone,
The lowest valley of my life,
I was flat on my face;
But then the great hand of Jesus,
Reached down and picked me up,
Oh! Yes, I know grace.

Chorus

Do you know grace, Amazing grace?
Have you heard, how sweet the sound,
There are many dangers, toils, and snares;
We’ve already faced, look where,
You came from and where you are,
And I’ll ask you do you know grace?

When it comes time,
For Him to take His bride,
