To that evergreen shore,
And He choo-ses you and I;
To live in that land forever more,
When we’ve been there,
Ten thousand years,
And you see me in that place;
Oh! You can ask me this question again,
I'll say yes, I remember grace.

title: OASIS OF LOVE
lyrics:
I came to this place from a dry thirsty land,
I drifted apart with no definite plans,
But words of the prophet of Malachi 4,
Turn one wasted life all around.

Chorus

I found an oasis of love,
The pastures are green year all round,
A new life is mine with peace from above,
I found an oasis of love.

I sing to my King, love and praise Him again,
Because of His love, a loser can win,
Hey! You on the desert of life come on in,
And drink from the cup offered free.

title: THAT DAY ON CALVARY
lyrics:
I was in the Garden of Eden,
With A-dam and Eve,
I was with Moses, the children of Israel,
Crossed the mighty Red Sea;
I was with King David,
When he shouted in the stream,
But the greatest place I’ve been,
Was that day on Calvary.

Chorus

That day on Calvary, I was at Calvary,
Every name in the Lamb’s Book of Life,
Was there that day,
Oh! I was on His mind;
The day that He died,
When He paid the price for me,
That day on the Calvary.

I was on the May flower, with the pilgrims,
When they sailed across the sea,
I was in Phila-del-phia,
Heard the Bell of Liberty;
I was with Abraham Lincoln,
When he set the slaves free,
But still the greatest place I’ve been,
Was that day on Calvary.

title: I JUST WANT TO BE WHERE YOU ARE
lyrics:
I just want to be where You are,
Dwelling daily in Your presence,
I don’t want to worship from afar,
Draw me near to where You are.

Chorus

I want to be where You are,
Dwelling in Your presence,
Feasting at Your table,
Surrounded by Your Glory;
In Your presence, that’s where,
I always want to be, I just want to be,
I just want to be with You.

I just want to be where You are,
In your dwelling place forever,
Take me to the place where You are,
For I just want to be with You.

BRIDGE:
Oh! My God,
You are my strength and my song,
And when I'm in Your presence,
Though I am weak, You're always strong.

title: RUNNING FOR MY LIFE
lyrics:
Oh! I’m in the race, into the rapture,
I’ve crossed the Jordan’s river,
Now I’m running to Canaan land;
I’m in the Stature of a Perfect Man,
I’m on the mountain, waiting for translation.

Chorus

I’m running, Yes! I’m running,
I’m running the race of my life,
I got to meet that Chariots on high,
To take my flight into the sky,
I’m running, I'm running for my life.

Doubt and unbelief,
They were heavy burdens,
Holding down my feet,
But I laid each weight aside;
By faith I got to take this flight,
I’m running, running for my life.

Pretty soon the chariots will swing low,
And when I hear that trumpet,
Sound, I got to go,
I got to hurry, I can’t be late;
My stop is at the pearly gate,
So I’m running the race of my life.

Faith, hope and charity,
They were blazing down,
That trail ahead of me;
But I caught them on the 7th peak,
I put all things under my feet,
And I'm running, running for my life.

Now in that chamber of the pyramid,
In that secret place with Jesus,
That is where I'm hid, You see,
He gave gave me a sneak preview;
Told me I'm one of His chosen few,
So I'm running, running for my life.

I've got to sing, I've got to shout,
You see, those Seven Thunders,
Sounding, they brought me out;
My destiny has been revealed,
I saw my name and I know I'm sealed,
And I'm running, running for my life.

title: IT’S MY DESIRE
lyrics:
It’s my desire to live for Jesus,
It's my desire to live for Him,
Though often I've failed Him,
And brought Him much shame,
It’s my desire, to live for Him.

Chorus

If you could see where,
Jesus brought me from,
To where I am today,
Then you would know;
The reason, why I love Him,
Now you can take the world’s wealth;
And riches, I don’t need earth's fame,
It’s my desire to live for Him.

It’s my desire, to help someone today,
Someone who may have failed, to see the way,
I too, was so long lost, but I found my way to God,
It's my desire, to live for Him.

title: LEAVING ON MY MIND
lyrics:
The old house, that I’ve been living in,
Is needing repair,
The windows and the shutters,
Are letting in the cold, cold air;
I said to myself, “I'm gonna fix them,”
When I can find the time,
But all I’m getting lately,
Is leaving on my mind.

Chorus

Lately all I've got, is leaving on my mind,
It seems that’s all I’ve been,
Thinking about, most of the time,
Soon, and very soon, I’ll leave;
My troubles far behind,
‘Cause all I'm getting lately,
Is leaving leaving on my mind.

I guess, I ought to be looking for,
A better place to live,
But I just can’t get excited about,
The world and what it can give;
I wouldn’t care if I could buy it all,
With a soli-tary dime,
For what would this world's goods do me;
With leaving on my mind.
(With the rapture on my mind).

title: WORD BE BORN IN YOU AND ME
lyrics:
She was a virgin bride-to-be,
And one night as she lay quietly,
The Spirit of the Lord overshadowed her,
And said that, "You’ll conceive a child,"
That sin cannot defile, and she said;
“Be it unto me according to Thy word,"
And she kept these things,
And pondered them deep within her heart,
She believed in God, when He said;
“That something new was going to start,
Oh! If the word could be born, in Ma-ry,
Well! It'll certainly be born in you and me.

Now we’re the virgin bride-to-be,
Saved through the blood of Calvary,
And in this time of darkness, we have come,
Received the Vindicated Word;
That we all have heard,
And I can see it being born in you and me,
‘Cause we’ve kept these things,
And pondered them deep within our hearts;
We’ve stayed with the Word,
Never one time felt desires to depart,
Oh! Yes the word has been born, in Ma-ry,
And I can see it being born in you and me.

title: JEHOVAH JIREH, MY PROVIDER
lyrics:
(Jehovah Jireh, my Provider
His Grace is sufficient for me )2x
My God shall supply all my needs,
According to His riches in Glory;
He gave His angels charge over me,
Jehovah Jireh cares for me, for me
Jehovah Jireh cares for me

title: LORD MOST HIGH
lyrics:
Lord Most High (2x)
You’re the King of Glory,
Forever Pure and Holy,
Lord Most High.

H-a-l-l-e-l-u-yah (2x)
We bow before Your throne,
And worship You alone,
H-a-l-l-e-l-u-yah.

title: SHELTERED IN THE ARMS OF GOD
lyrics:
I feel the touch of hands, so kind and gentle,
They’re leading me in paths that I must trod,
I'll have no fear, for Jesus walks beside me,
For I’m sheltered in, the arms of God.

Chorus

So let the storms rage on,
The dark clouds rise,
They won’t worry me,
For I’m sheltered safe;
Within the arms of God,
He walks with me, and naught
Of earth shall harm me,
For I’m sheltered in the arms of God.

Soon I shall hear, the call from Heaven's portals,
Come home, My child, it’s the last mile you must trod;
Then I’ll be changed and go to God’s sweet heaven,
Sheltered safe within the arms of God.

title: REMIND ME OF CALVARY
lyrics:
When my heart is filled with pain,
And I’m temp-ted to complain,
Remind me of Calvary!
When my hope is all but gone,
And I've almost lost myself,
Remind me of Calvary

Chorus

Remind me of Calvary,
Just remind me of Cal-vary,
When I don’t know what to do;
Teach me Lord, to trust in You,
Remind me of Calvary.

When my friends have let me down,
And there’s dark-ness all around,
Remind me of Calvary;
When they turn their back on me,
Teach me, Lord just to trust in Thee,
Remind me of Calvary.

title: ARISE POSSESS YOUR INHERITANCE
lyrics:
Entangled, with heavy chains of captivity,
Bruised and battered by sin, condemned,
And sentenced to a life of bondage;
Oh! God, there was no peace within,
And then a sound was heard,
It was like the abundance of rain;
Saying, "Rejoice,
You have received the atonement"
Accept the Pardoning Word,
Which was provided for you,
Because you’re not of the bondwoman,
You’re of the free.

Chorus

Arise, possess your inheritance,
For this is the year of Jubilee,
Arise, be not entangled;
With the yoke of bondage;
Understand the liberty,
By which Christ has set you free.

Aren’t you tired of living, underprivileged?
Saints, don’t you, don’t you hear that sound?
Saying, freedom to the captives,
Restoration to the blind;
Setting free those who are bruised,
Saints, empty your vessels,
Let Him fill them with oil,
You are free. (3x)

BRIDGE:
So, when the creditor comes,
To take away your land;
Show him your account,
Settled long ago by Calvary’s Lamb,
Saying, "I am free, I am free, I am free".

title: WHO IS WONDERFUL
lyrics:
Who is wonderful, It's Jesus,
Who is wonderful, It's Jesus,
Shout Hallelujah, Hallelujah. (2x)

title: I WAS THERE WHEN JESUS SAVED ME
lyrics:
There are some people,
Who say you cannot tell,
Whether we are saved,
Or whether all is well;
They say you only can hope,
And trust that it is so,
But I was there when it happened,
And I guess I ought to know.

Chorus

I was there when Jesus saved me (When He saved my soul)
The very moment He forgave me (Cleansed and made me whole)
Took away my heavy burden (Yes! He took my sin)
And He gave me peace within, (Gave me peace within)
Satan tries to make me doubt it (He can’t make me doubt it)
But I’m going to shout it (Yes! I’m gonna shout it)
I was there when it happened (Oh! my Lord)
And I guess I ought to know (I guess I ought to know)

I don’t care who tells you salvation is not real,
Though the world may argue, that you cannot feel,
The heavy burden lifted and vile sins go,
But I was there when it happened,
And I guess I ought to know.

title: THINK ABOUT HIS LOVE
lyrics:
Think about His love,
Think about His goodness,
Think about His grace;
That’s brought us through.
For as high as the heavens above;
So great is the measure,
Of our Father’s love,
Great is the measure.
Of our Father’s love.

title: I FEEL LIKE PRAISING HIM
lyrics:
When I wake up in the morning,
And think of the great things,
God has done for me,
In my heart there’s such a rejoicing;
To think that a new day, has dawned on me,
For the glorious mysteries in God’s Word,
That He has allowed me to share;
It’s only an indication of His great love,
And how much He cares.

Chorus

I feel like p-r-a-i-s-i-n-g Him
P-r-a-i-s-e Him
I feel like p-r-a-i-s-i-n-g Him
P-r-a-i-s-e Him

Like unto Abraham,
He came down, In this day unto me,
Showing me things that were,
And things that are, and things,
Things that are to be;
What has been hidden from,
The eyes of the wise and the prudent,
He has revealed unto His own;
For its a message of preparation,
To take us to our Eternal home.

When I think that I’m one in a million,
Chosen by God, to stand in this evil day,
It fills my heart with love for the Heavenly Dove;
Who has led me to God’s provided way,
I, who was dead in sins and trespasses,
So wretched, so wretched and so vile;
It took Amazing Grace, to lift me,
To that place where He calls,
Calls me His bride.

When I see all hell extending her borders,
To swallow, up humanity,
I thank the One With the keys of death and hell;
Who has opened the prison door for me,
He has change my course,
From the regions of the lost;
That realm of insanity, by anointing,
My eyes with a Heavenly vision,
To behold and live eternally.

title: I WILL RESTORE
lyrics:
Bride! Do you remember?
Way back to your former rain,
When you once, stood in position,
Having dominion and all things under your feet;
But you fell, you fell from that fellowship,
And you wondered, where you went wrong;
So you cry out, (Yes, you do),
You thirst for the latter rain,
And you’ll fight for that power again.

You see the palmerworm came in your life and ate,
Then the cankerworm came in your life and ate,
Then the caterpillar and locust ate,
But God promised, yes! He promised

Chorus

(That) "I will restore", saith the Lord (2x)
Jehovah promised, the Holy Ghost promised (Yes! He did)
"I will restore", Thus saith the Lord (2x)

Power, shall come from on high
After the Holy Ghost comes upon you
And you shall be witnesses,
Unto Me throughout the world
All My glory shall all men behold,

For I shall come, unto you as the former rain,
As the latter rain to you shall I come,
And all men shall know (testify),
That you have the evidence;
That Jesus, He rose from the dead.

And in your own atmosphere (At-mo-sphere)
The Lord will visit you there (Vi-sit you there)
For you were meant to be,
Mighty men of valour and He promised.

title: CONSUME ME LORD
lyrics:
Consume me Lord,
With the fire of Your Spirit,
Consume me Lord,
And make me more like You;
Break me Lord and bless,
The broken pieces of my life,
Let me be used, Lord by You.

title: JUST ONCE MORE LORD
lyrics:
Spiritual-ly stripped and morally broken,
With his eyes plucked out,
Here stands a man with all of his stature;
But with no power in his life.

Raised up by God and given power,
To put to flight the armies of the enemy,
But gave away all of his secrets,
Was now bound and in captivity.

In the book of his remembrance,
Were all the great victories he had won,
Realizing his present condition,
From deep down inside this cry began.

Chorus

Just once more, Lord,
Just once more, Lord,
So we can see (feel) your power,
Moving once again,
Just once more, Lord.

Inaugurated at Pentecost,
With Signs and wonders,
Manifestation of His Name;
But there at the Council of Nicaea,
The early church had its locks shaved,

With a promise of restoration,
We have seen God’s Church,
Rise in power through each stage,
Until God sent to us a prophet,
And we have seen the fullness,
Of God’s life on display.

But it’s been so long since,
The eyes have gone out,
And there is a new crop;
That is coming forth,
For greater works and dynamic;
Power to be displayed,
May we the Samsons of God,
Cry, “Just once more”.

title: HE’S THE CHRIST OF YESTERDAY, TODAY, FOREVER
lyrics:
He’s the Christ of Yesterday, Today, Forever,
And He's mine, Oh! Yes He's mine.

I was lost and deep down in sin,
I opened up my heart and I let Him in,
He’s the Christ of Yesterday,Today, Forever,
And He's mine oh! Yes He's mine.

title: WE TOO HAVE A THEOPHANY
lyrics:
Daddy! Is the Token applied for me?
And does the Spirit abide in me?
I want to know for sure,
Mummy! How are we so sure?
It is because we believe ,
The Prophet Malachi 4,
The Token is on the door,
We are saved forever more.

Chorus

We too have a Theophary,
A body waiting in the heavens for me,
We cannot wait to see,
What Eternity will be.

Now we know, we have a part to play,
To obey, all that the Prophet say,
The Token is a promise to them that obey,
Friends, it don’t matter if you're big or small;
Little stones are part of the building wall,
Believe in God today and you will find your way.

title: GOD’S GONNA BLESS YOU
lyrics:
You’ve been discouraged,
Feel like giving up, giving in,
'Cause you lost the love
Of folks you call friends;
But something is burning,
In your soul that’s Him,
God’s gonna bless you a-l-l-o-v-e-r.
‘
CHORUS
God’s gonna bless you,
All over again, that mountain,
Will fall if you’ll command,
Like a stream to a river;
To a sea without end,
God’s gonna bless you a-l-l-o-v-e-r. (Again.)

Hasn’t He been faithful,
Time and time again,
In the midst of your storms;
He’s always stepped in,
There’s no room to doubt a God,
Who always win, look up!
Get ready, let that miracle begin.

title: THE MESSENGER THAT CAME
lyrics:
The Messenger had come,
William Branham was his name,
God through him opened,
Up the Seven Seals;
He told us of the "Serpent Seed",
Many more things God revealed,
And he said, "Check it out with the word".

Chorus

He said, take God and repent,
And be bapti-zed in the Name,
Of the Lord Jesus Christ,
Ye shall receive the Holy Ghost;
Not many days hence,
And these signs shall follow them.

Thank God, thank God,
For the prophet He sent this day,
Or else He has to smite,
The earth with a curse;
Get down on your knees and pray,
And ask God to lead the way,
Through this prophet,
God showed us the way.

title: SINCE GOD DREW ME
lyrics:
Like the prodigal son in sin,
I wandered far away from,
My Father’s home, although;
I thought that I had the answer,
Success in life was my goal,
But the farther I ran, more sorrow I beheld,
Till I came to the end of my road.

Chorus

Since God drew me
I found joy everlasting joy in my soul,
Since God drew me, I have peace
Resting peace within my soul

Like Joshua and Caleb, I want to go,
Through till I reach that promise land,
And I know each day that,
He will help me overcome;
By His amazing grace,
By faith I see the victory ahead,
Praise God! Hallelujah,
I'm shouting victory.

title: I WANT TO STROLL OVER HEAVEN WITH YOU
lyrics:
If I surveyed all the good things,
That comes to me from above,
If I count all the blessings;
From the storehouse of love,
I’d simply ask for a favour;
Of Him beyond mortal ken,
And I’m sure that He’ll grant it again.

Chorus

I want to stroll over heaven,
With you some glad day,
When all our troubles and heartaches;
Are vanished away, then we’ll enjoy,
All the beauty where all things are new,
I wanna to stroll over heaven with you.

So many places of beauty,
We long to see here below,
But time and treasures have kept us;
From making plans as you know,
But come the morning of the rapture,
Together we’ll stand anew,
While I stroll over heaven with you.

title: JESUS I LOVE YOU
lyrics:
Jesus I love You, Jesus I love You,
You’ve been so good to me,
Jesus I love You, Jesus I love You,
You’ve been so good to me (3x)
Jesus! I love You,
O! Jesus I love You,
You’ve been so good to me

(Jesus I praise You....).

title: HIS STRENGTH IS PERFECT
lyrics:
His strength is perfect,
When our strength is gone,
He’ll carry us, when we can’t carry on;
Rest in His power, the weak becomes strong,
His strength is perfect,
His strength is perfect.

title: MIDNIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF THE DAY
lyrics:
The sun was hot, an angry mob,
Gathered by the great stone building,
As a man draped in velvet,
With a curly black beard,
Stepped out on his balcony,

Nervously washing his hands,
To rid him of the blood,
Pilate never washed away,
His wrinkled brow,
Showed the worried lines,
I heard Pilate say,
"I found no fault in this Man called, Jesus",
The Healer from the Shores of Galilee.

I command you to ask,
To let Him go free,
Don’t make me take His blood,
To the grave with me.

Nervously washing his hands,
To rid him of the blood,
It would never wash away,
The mob screamed for blood,
Of this Innocent Man,
I heard Pilate pray.

Chorus

And it was midnight,
In the middle of the day,
Trembling soldiers fell,
Before Jesus crossed the veil,
The whole world shook,
The veil was rent from the centre,
As Christ was slain,
And it was midnight,
In the middle of the day.

title: FATHER IN HEAVEN HOW WE LOVE YOU
lyrics:
Father in Heaven how we love You,
We lift Your Name, in all the earth,
May Your kingdom, be established in our praises,
As Your people, we declare Your mighty works.

Chorus

Blessed be the Lord God Almighty,
Who WAS and IS and IS TO COME,
Blessed be the Lord God Almighty,
Who reigns forever more.

title: I’LL DIE BELIEVING
lyrics:
As Satan stands before You,
Accusing me of sin,
The pressure is unceasing, Lord!
I know with whom I've been;
The wall should fall around me,
In Your word I'll stand,
Your hand, in mine to guide me,
To my promise land.

Chorus

I’ll die believing,
The difference the Token makes,
I’ll die believing,
If that’s what it takes;
I’ll die believing,
The catching away of Your bride;
I’ll die believing,
You’re living inside.

Past sins recalled to memory,
My thought won’t let me be,
The greatest battle ever fought,
Rages on in me;
Although I look defeated now,
Just wait around and see,
The Spirit of the Living God,
Do battle for me.

Your Spoken Word made flesh in me,
Preparing a bride for eter-nity,
The Stature of a Perfect Man,
Is Your plan for me;
Recognizing Your Word in this day,
Called, Elected, Anointed and Placed,
In service for the Living God,
The Capstone soon we shall meet.

title: QUICKENED, CHANGED, TRANSLATED
lyrics:
Oh! I’m quickened, changed, translated
By the power of the Holy Ghost,
And I’m waiting for the outward,
To be changed and taken off the earth;
(For) His power now is moving,
It’s deep inside of me,
When I look into the mirror,
I know it’s Him I see.

title: SOMETHING IS BREAKING
lyrics:
A Seal breaks open, a man caught a vision,
Heard the voice of a prophet saying, “Sail on, sail on”
And just like Abraham,
He’s in search of another land,
The unseen is now being made visible,
As dove leads eagle.

Chorus

Something is breaking
Between mortal and immortal
The SON’s coming up removing
The darkness of night
The key’s being given, opening dimensions
Life and immortality is coming to light

When crisis arises the world gets in birth pains,
They see the need for us to move forward,
Then an anointing falls upon the vessel;
Who has been ordained,
To lift us up to another plane.

Through each unfolding, the way is opening,
Spiritual scientist working by laws,
To achieve this Rapturing Faith,
Thru secret passages, seven steps up the pyramid,
Where we’ll run through death,
And leap over into supernatural realms.

CHORUS:
Something is breaking,
Between mortal and immortal,
The SON’s coming up removing;
The darkness of night
After this mountain and eternity sets in,
And that’s the real world,
We’re gonna live in.

title: HIS WORD IS MY COMFORT
lyrics:
His Word is my comfort,
His Word is my shield,
His Word is my wheel ;
In the middle of the wheel,
My feets are standing on it,
It shall not pass away (and) I shall keep on,
Standing on His word each day.

title: WHEN HE WAS ON THE CROSS
lyrics:
He walked the road to Calvary,
The rugged Cross He bore,
A crowd stood by and watched this Man,
They'd heard Him preached before,
Though His eyes was on that crowd that day,
He looked ahead in time
When He was on the Cross,
I was on His mind.

Chorus

For He knew me, yet He loved me,
He Whose Glory makes the Heaven shine,
So unworthy, of such mercy,
Yet when He was on the Cross,
I was on His mind.

The look of love, was on His face,
And thorns were on His head,
The blood was on that scarlet rope
And stained a crimson red,
Though His eyes were on the crowd that day,
He looked ahead in time,
For when He was on the Cross
I was on His mind

title: GOD WILL TAKE CARE OF YOU
lyrics:
Be not dismayed, whate’er betide,
God will take care of you,
Beneath His wings of love abide,
God will take care of you.

Chorus

God will take care of you (me)
Through every day, o'er all the way
He will take care of you (me)
God will take care of you (me)

Through days of toil,
When heart doth fail,
God will take care of you (me),
When dangers fierce your path assail,
God will take care of you (me).

title: THE GREATEST MORNING EVER
lyrics:
I woke up this morning,
Wondering could this be the day,
When those who beneath us resting;
Would arise to bring on that new day,
Then my heart began to beat for joy;
Knowing what day that will be,
For the bride will go to meet Jesus
The bridegroom she so loved to see.

Chorus

It will be the greatest morning ever,
When our loved ones again, we behold,
This time we’ll meet never to part,
With Jesus always we’ll be.

The signs and times are telling us,
That this is the day He’ll return,
There's wars and earth quakes everywhere,
Heart failing for the troubles they see;
And the prophet has cried out again,
Oh! People return back to God,
For Jesus is coming for a bride,
Whose garment are spotless and white.

title: LET YOUR LOVE SHINE THROUGH ME
lyrics:
Let Your love shine through me,
O! Lord (2x)
Let it shine so bright,
Leading others to the light.
Let Your love shine through me,
O! Lord (2x)

All I want in this world Lord, is You (2x)
That’s my only desire,
Everyday and every hour
All I want in this world Lord, is You (2x)

title: PROUD TO BE A CHRISTIAN
lyrics:
Oh! I’m proud to be a Christian, Halleluyah!
And I’m glad to know my name is written there,
And I’m proud to know that Jesus is my Saviour,
(And I’m glad to know He sent to me His prophet),
My Heavenly Father wrote my name up there.

title: HE’LL MAKE A WAY
lyrics:
Looking for answers, you need a way out,
You’ve been trapped in that trial
Full of sorrow and doubt
You saw a trickle of sunlight,
But you found no escape,
Just hold on to His promises
He said that, He’ll make a way.

Chorus

He’ll make a way,
In the middle of no where.
When it’s seem no one really care,
He’s there by your side,
He’ll make a way,
When you feel Satan close in,
Don’t give up, don’t give in,
He’ll make a way right on time

Standing at the Red Sea, no place to go,
Pharaoh’s army was closing in,they’d soon overthrow,
Right out of nowhere came a Mighty Strong hand
He rolled back the water and made a way out again.

title: SUN OF MY SOUL
lyrics:
Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
Oh! May no earth-born cloud a-rise,
To hide Thee from Thy servant’s eye.

When the soft dews of kindly sleep,
My wearied eyelids gently steep,
Be my last thought – How sweet to rest,
For ever on my Saviour’s breast!

Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live,
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

Come near and bless us when we wake,
'Ere through the world our way we take,
Till, in the ocean of Thy love,
We lose ourselves in heaven above.

title: OLD GOSPEL SHIP
lyrics:
I have good news to bring and that is why I sing,
All of my joys with you I’ll share,
I’m gonna take a trip, In the old Gospel ship,
And go sailing through the air.

Chorus

I’m gonna take a trip,
In the old gospel ship,
I’m going far beyond the sky,
I’m gonna shout and sing,
Until the heavens ring,
While I’m bidding this world good bye

If you’re ashamed of me, you have no cause to be,
For with Christ, I am an heir
And through the path you find, you gonna be left behind,
As I go sailing through the air

I can hardly wait, I know I’ll not be late,
I’m going to spend all of my time in prayers,
When that ship comes in, I’ll leave this world of sin,
And go sailing through the air.

title: WITHIN ME
lyrics:
Down here below I am not much at all,
Down here below, I really am quite small,
But within me there lives someone,
Who made the earth, the moon and the sun.

Chorus

Oh! Within me (Oh! Within me)
There lives someone (There lives someone)
Said let there be and it was done
Oh! Within me (Oh! Within me)
Though I am small (Though I am small)
There lives a King, the All in All

If Satan tries to lay a trap for me,
I do not fear, for Jesus said to me,
"Greater is He that is in thee"
Than all the lies of the enemy.

title: WAIT FOR AN ANSWER FROM THE LORD
lyrics:
When troubles comes and things go wrong,
And you have lost your heart sweet song,
Just wait for an answer from the Lord,
Don’t hang down your head and cry,
Just lift your face up to the sky,
And wait for an answer from the Lord.

Chorus

(Just) Wait for an answer,
Wait for an answer,
(Just) wait for an answer from the Lord;
There’s never a problem too small,
There’s never a mountain too tall,
Just wait for an answer from the Lord.

When you pray and tears fall down like rain,
And every prayer seems to be in vain,
Just wait for an answer from the Lord,
Now look up, have faith that is in mind,
The Lord will answer in His good time,
Just wait for an answer from the Lord.

title: I SAW THE LIGHT
lyrics:
I wandered so aimless, My life filled with sin,
I wouldn't let my dear Saviour in,
Then Jesus came like stranger in the night,
Praise the Lord, I saw the Light.

Chorus

I saw the Light (2x)
No more darkness, no more night ,
Now I'm so happy, no sorrow in sight,
Praise the Lord, I saw the Light

Just like a blind man, I wandered along,
Worries and cares I claimed for my own,
And like a blind man that God gave back his sight,
Praise the Lord I saw the Light.

title: ACROSS THE BRIDGE
lyrics:
I had lived a life of sin,
In this world we're living in,
I have done forbidden things,
I shouldn’t do,
I asked a stranger along the way;
If he could tell me where to stay,
Where I could find,
Real happiness and love that's true.

Chorus

Across the bridge, there’s no more sorrow
Across the bridge,there’s no more pain
The sun will shine across the river
And we’ll never be unhappy again.

Just follow the footsteps of the King
Till you hear the voices ring
They’ll be singing out
The glory of the Lamb
The river Jordan will be near
The sound of trumpets you will hear
You’ll behold, the sweetest voice
Ever known to man

title: JESUS LOVING JESUS
lyrics:
Sometimes I get so weary,
Sometimes I feel so blue,
And at times when I take one step;
I fall back two, but then my mind,
Goes back to the promises You gave.
And one more time I'll rise above the world.

Chorus

Jesus, Loving Jesus
You’re the only way I can go on,
(I cry) Jesus Loving Jesus
Who love me enough to save me
From this world of sin

Oh! Lord our days are shortened here,
There’s trials on every hand,
And there’s no hope for this life here below,
So help me always to be a man, admit,
Where I’ve gone wrong, and someday,
Lord! We’ll sing a brand new song.

title: DYING TO BE RE-UNITED
lyrics:
Always inside of me,
There was a deep that was calling,
But there never was, a deep to respond,
Then my heart began searching, I didn’t know what for,
Until that day He came, until He called my name
Now I can never, never, ever be the same

Chorus

I'm dying to be re-united and in my soul I'm excited
I'm dying to be re-united, with the One,
Who’s always known me.

Indeed He came to me, but that wasn’t all,
The words He spoke to me, controls my heart,
And daily I die a death, unseen to human eyes
Until they see in me, God manifested in the flesh,
And I can never, never, ever, be the same.

title: I KEEP COMING BACK TO THE WELL
lyrics:
Blessed is the fountain in a barren land
That satisfies the thirst of the inner man
No better place to be found to dwell
Oh! Won’t you come to the well?

Chorus

I keep coming back to the Well of grace,
Great is the power and sweet is the taste
Whenever temptation and trials I face
I keep coming back to the Well

Jesus is the Well at Calvary
For healing, cleansing and victory,
How it's joy overflow,
No tongue can tell
I thank God for the Well

title: SING ME A SONG ABOUT CALVARY
lyrics:
There is an empty tomb in Jerusalem
Today that plainly to us testify
That He who slept there no longer is dead
But liveth and reigneth on high (and)
Just as sure, as He came before
Suffered and died for my sins,
Just about sure what I feel in my heart
Makes me know He’s soon coming again

Chorus

Sing me a song about Calvary
Show me its sufferings and loss
Tell it till each part of my soul shall cry,
Thank God for the old rugged Cross.

They said, "soon each mountain
And high lofty place will be brought down
At God’s will", If in my heart forever,
Will stand, a vision of Golgotha’s tree,
'Cause that's where Jesus,
My Saviour and Lord gladly the sacrifice paid
So when I repented, I came to His throne
I found sin’s debt’s already was paid.

title: ALMOST HOME
lyrics:
I love Jesus, Yes! I do
He loves me, I know it’s true
And one day, I'll look upon His face I know
But I’ll wait until that day
When my Lord calls me away
For it’s just a little while
And we’ll be home

Chorus

Almost home, we’re almost home
Oh! The time is drawing near,
A Heavenly light it shall come down
Change my body and I’ll not be found
For it’s just a little while and we’ll be home

Sometimes it seem so hard to wait,
But His promise won’t be late,
For He always keeps His words this I know,
So I'll keep on pressing on,
I believe it won’t be long for,
It’s just a little while and we’ll be home.

title: THE NAME OF THE LORD IS A STRONG TOWER
lyrics:
The Name of the Lord is a Strong Tower,
The righteous run into it and they are safe,
The Name of the Lord is a Strong Tower
The righteous run into it and they are safe

Blessed be the Name of the Lord,
Blessed be the Name of the Lord,
Blessed be the Name of the Lord;
Most High
Blessed be the Name of the Lord
Blessed be the Name of the Lord
Blessed be the Name of the Lord
Most High

title: I DON’T WANT NOTHING TO HINDER ME
lyrics:
One day I heard a voice, He said,
If you make Me your choice,
I’ll drive away your every care
And set you free, so I came to Him
That day and He took my sins away,
I don’t want nothing here to hinder me.

Chorus

I don’t want nothing here to hinder me,
For someday His blessed face, I want to see,
It makes no difference what the cost
Or how heavy the Cross,
I don’t want nothing here to hinder me

Often times I'm tossed about,
Often times I do without,
Often times my heart is filled;
With grief and pain,
But if only I stand true
He will see me through,
I don’t want nothing here to hinder me.

Now some day when I get home,
And my journey on earth is done,
With my Jesus and my loved ones
I shall be, I will lay my old Cross down
And receive a shinning crown,
I don’t want nothing here to hinder me.

title: HE STILL SPEAKS
lyrics:
Amidst the hustling, clamouring world,
Sometimes it’s hard to hear
The voice of God speaking to my soul,
But in my quiet time alone
When I approach His Holy throne
His tender words fall gently on my ears.

Chorus

He still speaks, I know His voice
Sweeter sound never heard by mortal ears,
And to think that God by His own choice
Would speak to me, it makes me rejoice,
He still speaks I know His voice.

There are so many who still doubt,
That God can speak today,
They laugh and mock when we say,
We’ve heard from God;
But the still small voice of God is heard,
Above the doubters of this world,
His timeless words rings out with hope today.

title: IT’S WORTH IT ALL, IT’S WORTH IT ALL
lyrics:
I don’t want a mansion on the hill side,
I don’t care for wealth or worldly fame,
I don’t worry when those around me,
Prosper so, for I have Jesus
And that’s worth everything.

Chorus

It’s worth it all to feel, this fire
That's burning deep within
It’s worth it all to know (that) I’m saved
And free from sin, just to feel His touch,
And know that He's coming back again,
It’s worth it all, it’s worth it all.

Once my life was dark and oh! So empty
Everyday I live with, sin and shame
Then those nail-scarred hands
Reached down and gently touch me
Now I have Jesus
And that’s worth everything.

title: I WON’T WALK WITHOUT JESUS
lyrics:
Used to be when I was sinning,
Satan stood off somewhere grinning,
As the pleasures that he brought;
Just turn on me,
Teardrops came like rain a falling
Untill I heard my Saviour calling,
If you can’t go on anymore,
Just lean on Me

Chorus

And I won’t walk without Jesus,
I won’t talk without Jesus
I refuse to live one day as before
No! I won’t go without Jesus,
It just aint't so without Jesus
Everything that I would do
I just won’t do, without the Lord

A beggar, lame at the gate just sitting,
And all his life he’d been regretting,
He'd never stood or took a stroll
On down the street
Then Peter and John happened by his way
“Look upon us!” Peter did say,
“In the Name of the Lord, "Rise up and walk"
And he leaped to his feet

title: WHY DON’T YOU LEAD ME TO THE ROCK
lyrics:
There’s a Rock,
That is higher than the mountain,
There’s a Rock,
That is deeper than the sea.
There’s a Rock,
That will lead you to eternity.
There’s a Rock for me.

Chorus

Why don’t You lead me to that Rock,
That is higher than I.
Lead me, Oh! Lead me.
Why don’t You lead me to that Rock,
That is higher than I.
Thou has been a Shelter for me.

title: THE MORE THAT I SURRENDER
lyrics:
And it gets easier to understand,
This road I’m traveling down,
No more wavering no wandering,
I’m standing on solid ground,
And I know I’m headed
To my Future Home and the voice I hear
Is Yours alone, every day I live,
Lord, I love You more.

Chorus

The more that I surrender,
The lighter my load.
The more that I release my cares,
The more You take control.
The more that I can humble myself,
The more You lift me up.
Every day I live, Lord I love You more.

The problems I had yesterday
Are but stepping stones to a higher place
The trials that seem so awesome to me
Are now my banners of victory
And I know I’m headed
To my Future Home and the voice I hear
Is Yours alone every day I live,
Lord, I love You more.

title: IT’S GOING HOME TIME
lyrics:
It’s going home time,
We’re justified by faith,
It’s going home time
We’re sanctified by the blood
It’s going home time
We’re full of the Holy Ghost
It’s going home time
And the bride is about to leave (go)

title: I’VE GOT CONFIDENCE
lyrics:
When the chips are down
And the going gets rough
Look up to the Rock
From whence you’re hewn

Chorus

Oh! I’ve got confidence
The Lord has never failed me yet.
No matter what the case may be.
I know He’ll see me through

He’s a Present help, in the time of trouble
He’s a Rock of refuge in a weary land

He sent us Elijah, to forerun His coming
And He sent us the Thunders
For the Bride’s Revival

Thank God there’s a man here
Who can turn on the light
So fear not, “Little Bride” for all is well

title: IS ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR GOD?
lyrics:
It’s out of your hands, you’ve done all you can do,
You’ve given God the problem, It’s no longer up to you
You’ve prayed the prayer of faith, standing on God’s truth
While you’re waiting on the answer
He has a question for you

Chorus

Is anything too hard for God?
Who’s got a problem beyond,
His power to solve?
Are there situations,
He’s not the master of?
Is anything too hard for God?

Only believe, trust His Word, you’ll see,
His plans are now unfolding, performing perfectly
It’s clear how much He loves you, look at all He's done
For all your questions, there’s really only one

title: LORD I CAN’T EVEN WALK WITHOUT YOU HOLDING MY HAND
lyrics:
I thought (that) number one would surely be me,
I thought I could be what I wanted to be,
I thought I could build on life sinking sand,
But I can’t even walk, without You holding my hand

Chorus

(Lord) I can’t even walk
Without You holding my hands
The mountain's too high and the valley’s too wide
Down on my knees, I had to stay
Lord, I can’t even walk without You holding my hand

I thought that I could do a lot on my own
I thought I could make it all, all alone
I thought, thought of myself, as a mighty big man
But I can't even walk, without You holding my hand

I think I'll make Jesus my one and all,
From now on when in trouble, on Him I’ll call,
And if I can’t trust Him, I’d be less of a man
Cause I can’t even walk, without You holding my hand.

title: HOLDING MY HAND AS ONLY YOU CAN HOLD IT
lyrics:
Lord! You gave me a life without sorrow,
And a home where my problems are few,
But if it all comes to pieces tomorrow,
I'd like to know that I have You.

Chorus

Holding my hands as You only can hold it,
Whispering peace like no other can do,
I won’t worry for fame and fortune,
If I only know that I have You

And at last when this life is all over
And Jordan's chilly waters I view,
And no matter who’s standing around me,
(Lord) I just like to know that, I have You.

title: CHAMPION OF LOVE
lyrics:
Ladies and gentlemen
May I have your attention
I'd like to introduce to you
In this corner of the good and the right
Stands a champion, robed in white
His height exceeds the heavens
His weight outweighs the world
His reach reaches everywhere
His age is evermore

Chorus

He is higher than the highest
He is greater than the greatest
No one will ever take His crown away
He’s more mighty than the mightiest
He reigns from above
He’s the all-time, undisputed, undefeated
Champion of Love

He left His hometown
To enter this arena
To raise His hands in victory for me
An angry crowd cried, "Crucified"
This King who wore their crown
As they watched the champion
Going down but I will never count
Him out for I’m a witness
Of the day He rose to reclaim
“Champion of Love"

title: I'D RATHER HAVE JESUS
lyrics:
I’d rather have Jesus, than silver or gold
I’d rather have Jesus, than riches untold
I’d rather have Jesus, than houses or land,
I’d rather be led, by His nail pierced hand

Chorus

Than to be the king of a vast domain,
And be held in sins dread sway,
I’d rather have Jesus, than anything,
This world affords today.

I’d rather have Jesus, than men’s applause,
I’d rather be true to His dear cause,
I’d rather have Jesus, than world wide fame
I’d rather be true to His Holy Name

title: I’M WAITING DOWN HERE AT THE RIVER
lyrics:
Hear my prayer Lord,
Oh! Lord hear my prayer
I know You heard me prayed,
So many times before,
I need You, if You don’t come
I’ll perish, I’m waiting on You, Lord
Right down here below.

Chorus

I’m waiting down here at the river
Will You come Lord Jesus?
Satan don’t want me to cross
No! Satan don’t want me to cross
I’m waiting down here at the river,
Will You come Lord Jesus?
If You don’t come to my rescue
I’ll be lost.

I’m Your child Lord,
And I know, I belong to You,
I’m Your child Lord!
And I know I can’t do without You
But Satan tried so hard
To make me doubt You
(But) I’m so glad that I have seen Mal. 4
(Too much about You)

title: BREATHE ON ME, BREATH OF GOD
lyrics:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

Breathe on me Breath of God
Blend all my soul with Thine,
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

Breathe on me, Breath of God;
So shall I never die,
But live with Thee the perfect life
Of Thine eternity.

title: SO MUCH TO THANK HIM FOR
lyrics:
When I look around and see
The good things He does for me,
I know that I'm unworthy of them all,
For His blessings He freely gives
I owe my whole life to Him
I’ve got so much to thank Him for

CHORUS:
I’ve got so much to thank Him for,
So much to praise Him for,
You see God has been so good to me,
And when I think of what He’s done
And where He brought me from.
I’ve got so much to thank Him for.

Sometimes along life's way
I kneel and I stop and say, "Thank you Lord"
For all You’ve done for me,
(But) Some day when I reach heaven’s shore
Lord please let me kneel just once more
I’ve got so much to thank Him for.

I wanna thank Him for letting me
See this last day End Time Mystery
And I know that my name, is on the book,
For the Seals, they have been revealed,
Any day now, that body change we could feel.
I’ve got so much to thank Him for.

title: HEAR MY CRY OH GOD
lyrics:
Hear my cry oh! God,
Attend unto my prayer
From the ends of the earth
Will I cry unto Thee,
When my heart is overwhelmed,
Lord, lead me to the Rock,
That is higher than I,
That is higher than I

title: WE ARE TRAVELLING ON THE RIGHT ROAD
lyrics:
We are travelling on the right road
We believe the pro-phet He sent
There is only one way to the City of God,
We are traveling on the right road

title: NO NEVER ALONE
lyrics:
I’ve seen the lightning flashing
And heard the thunders rolled
I’ve felt sins breakers, dashing
Trying to conquer my soul,
But I heard the voice of my Saviour
Telling me, still to fight on
And He promised never to leave me
Never to leave me alone.

Chorus

No never alone
No never alone
He promised never to leave me
Never to leave me alone

The world's fierce winds are blowing,
Temptation’s sharp and keen
I feel a peace in knowing
My Saviour stands in between
He stands to shield me from danger
When earthly friends are gone
He promised never to leave me,
Never to leave me alone.

title: STANDING ON THE SOLID ROCK
lyrics:
Through my disappointment,
Strife and discontemptment
I cast my every care upon the Lord,
No matter what obsessions
Pain or deep depression
I'm standing on the Solid Rock

Chorus

I'm standing on the Rock of Ages
Safe from every storms that rages
Rich but not from Satan's wages
I'm standing on the Solid Rock.

Even though He's gone now,
I don’t feel alone now
With comfort came the Spirit of the Lord,
Now with His word to guide me,
From temp-tation hide me,
I'm standing on the Solid Rock

Now I'm pressing onward,
Each step leads me homeward,
I'm trusting in my Saviour day by day
Close is our relation, firm is it’s foundation
So on this Solid Rock I'll stay.

title: I'VE LEARNED HOW TO LEAN
lyrics:
I learned how to lean
And depend on Jesus
He’s my friend and He’s my guide
I learned how to lean
And depend on Jesus,
I found out if I trust Him
He will provide (deliver)

What a fellowship,
What a joy divine
Leaning on His arm,
What a blessedness
What a peace of mind
Leaning on His arm

Oh! How sweet to walk
In the narrow way
Leaning on His arm
Oh! How bright the path
Grows from day to day
Leaning on His arm

title: A SINNER’S FRIEND
lyrics:
It was for sinners Jesus came
To die upon a Cross of shame
He shed His blood to set us free
And saved the lives of you and me

Chorus

It was for you, it was for me
He walked the road to Calvary
Such love I’ll never compre-hend
That He would be, a sinner’s friend

Such mercies I could nev’r repay
But I can serve Him everyday
I’ll sing forever of His grace
And someday thank Him face to face

title: WHAT MANNER OF MAN IS JESUS
lyrics:
What manner of man is Jesus, Hallelujah (2x)
Hallelujah ! Hallelujah!!! Amen
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!!! Amen

title: THIS IS YOUR HOUSE COME AND DWELL
lyrics:
We have set aside
This temple for You, Lord,
Let Your glory filled this sanctuary,
Be enthroned in the presence
Of Your people
Lord we agree in unity

Chorus

This is Your house,
Father! Come and dwell,
This is Your house,
A Holy house of prayer,
Where the lost and the lonely
Bring their burdens and their cares,
This is Your house (2x)
Lord! Come and dwell

Holy Spirit overflow this place
Lord! Decorate our walls
With grace and mercy,
Let healing and redemption
Find searching souls.
Lord have Your way,
We humbly pray

title: WHAT MORE DO YOU WANT HIM TO DO
lyrics:
There is a man, His Name,
His Name is Jesus,
He used to live in this world,
We’re going through,
He died and He's gone
To prepare a place for you (me)
What more do you want Him to do?

Chorus

What more do you want Him to do?
To prove that He l-o-v-e you, He do,
He (Jesus) died on the Cross
To save, save us all,
What more do you want Him to do?

In this world we' re living, we have trials,
But if we only keep the Faith
He’ll take us through, (Yes! He will)
Keep trusting in His Name
And don’t you be ashamed,
What more do you want Him to do?

title: HIDE THOU ME
lyrics:
Sometimes I feel discouraged,
And think my life's in vain,
I’m tempted then to murmur,
And of my lots complain;
But when I think of Jesus,
And all He’s done for me,
Then I cry, Oh! Rock of ages,
Hide Thou me.

Chorus

Oh! Rock of Ages, Hide Thou me,
No other refuge, have I but Thee,
When life’s dark vale I wander,
Far, far from thee;
Then, I cry, Oh! Rock of Ages,
Hide Thou me.

Sometimes it seems I dare not
Go one step farther on,
And from my heart all courage
Has slipped away and gone;
But I remember Jesus,
And all His love for me,
Then I cry, Oh! Rock of Ages,
Hide Thou me.

Oh! what a friend is Jesus,
Sure Anchor for my soul,
So Tender, True and Gracious,
I’m safe in His control
My Help in time of danger,
My Strong Defense is He,
Oh! Thou blessed Rock of Ages,
Hide Thou me.

title: WHAT A MIGHTY GOD WE SERVE
lyrics:
What a Mighty God we serve
What a Mighty God we serve
Heaven and earth adore Him
Angels bow before Him
What a Mighty God we serve

JESUS IS THE LORD we serve
JESUS IS THE LORD we serve
Heaven and earth adore Him
Angels bow before Him
JESUS IS THE LORD we serve.

title: GOD WITH SKIN ON HIM
lyrics:
I look back when I was living,
Among the dead out there
Revelation 18:4 called me,
Praise God now I am free.

Chorus

Thank God for the seed germ in me.
No more the sin of soul for me,
I've heard from John 16:13.
God with skin on Him today.

Sure the sheaf has been waved today
That gives my soul Sabbath.
I’m not following a man’s word
But THE WORD incarnate today.

Friends, whatever life may produce.
Bitter, rough or sweet,
Learn to trust and never complain,
Victory will be yours at last.

title: I’VE LEARNED TO TRUST HIM
lyrics:
He gave me joy
When I didn’t have no joy at all
He gave me peace
When I had no peace at all
And in each disappointment
He was there to see me through
And said “If you will trust Me
That’s all you have to do”.

Chorus

I’ve learned to trust Him (2x)
In every step I take, He walks with me
On mountains high above
In valleys so deep and low
Wherever that I may go
I’ve learned to trust Him.

He gave me love
That I had never known before
When no one wanted me
And they put me from their door
It made me sad, but soon, I was glad
To know that One loved me and that
Same One loves me, even eternally

title: THROUGH IT ALL
lyrics:
I’ve had many tears and sorrows,
I’ve had questions for tomorrow,
There've been times I didn’t know
Right from wrong;
But in every situation,
God gave blessed consolation,
That my trials come
To only make me strong.

Chorus

Through it all, through it all,
I’ve learned to trust in Jesus,
I’ve learned to trust in God;
Through it all, through it all,
I’ve learned to depend upon His word

I’ve been in a lot of places,
And I’ve seen a lot of faces,
But sometimes I've felt so all alone;
But in those lonely hours,
Those precious lonely hours,
Jesus came and let me know
I was His own.

I thank God for the mountains,
And I thank Him for the valley,
And I thank Him for the trials
He's brought me through;
(For) if I never had a problem,
I'd never know my God could solve them
I'd never know what faith in
His Word could do.

title: JESUS ALL FOR JESUS
lyrics:
(Jesus, all for Jesus
All I am and I ever hope to be) 2x

(All of my ambitions, hopes and plans,
I surrender these, into Your hands) 2x

For it's only in Your Will that I am free } 2x
Jesus, all for Jesus all I am,
And I, ever hope to be.

title: I'VE GOT THE LIFE OF GOD
lyrics:
I‘ve got the life of God in me (2x)
I‘ve got His life, His nature, and His abilities
I‘ve got the life of God in me.

title: YOU’VE GOT TO RUN
lyrics:
There are people all over the world
To whom this Message must be told;
All those honest in heart,
In this Light they have a part.

Chorus

You’ve got to run ,run ,run ,run ,
Run with the Message of Malachi 4,
You’ve got to tell it
Like you’ve never told it before;
Let him that readeth run,
Let him that heareth run,
For this Message
Is the coming of the Lord.

Always ready to give a reason,
Be instant in and out of season,
Willing to take this blessed hope
To a lost and dying world.

Seeing we have this Ministry,
Let’s not faint but earnestly seek
To build the Kingdom of God,
For the glory of the Lord.

title: FOUNTAIN OPEN
lyrics:
For I will take you from the nations
And bring you to your own land,
And I’ll be sanctified in you,
Before the eyes of man,
A new heart will I give you,
And place My Spirit within,
I’ll sprinkle clean water on you,
And save you from your sin.

Chorus

There is a fountain opened
In the House of David
To you who would believe,
And there are streams of Grace
That’s flowing down from Calvary,
Come, now and receive.

And I will pour upon the house
Of My Chosen one, the Spirit of Grace
And of supplication and in that day,
What a day that will be,
A fountain shall be opened up,
And you shall be wholly clean.

title: CHOICES WE MAKE
lyrics:
So He told you through sickness
And health, poverty (and) wealth,
He’d never leave you
He’ll not forsake you,
He’d be there for you, only you never
Pray for God to show you the way.
So it didn’t last “Death we do part”
For the rest of your days.
You have to pay because
Of choices you made.

Chorus

Choices we make will determine
The kind of road we take,
You can live with disappointment
And doubt, pain and heartache
Or you can lay down in green pasture.
Drink milk and honey from the Canaan land,
O! If we would just pray for every
Step that we take and
The choices we make.

As a believer, I've spent many years now
Down in the valley of despair,
I wasn’t being tried by the Lord,
My wrong choices put me there,
Most of my wounds have been
Self inflicted, like we always term,
If everyman would learn
To pray for God’s will in every step
We take and all the choices we make

title: LET YOUR WORD BE BORN
lyrics:
Let Your Word be born,
In the manger of my heart (soul)
Let it live in me, let it shine
Live inside this house of clay,
And mould me everyday
Let Your Word be born
In the manger of my soul (heart)

title: I LIVE FOR JESUS
lyrics:
I live for Jesus, day after day
I live for Jesus, let come what may
The Holy Spirit, I will obey
I live for Jesus day after day

title: BLESSED BE
lyrics:
You Oh! Lord,
Are a Strong and Mighty Tower
An Ever Present Help, in my darkest hour
You’re my Hiding Place,
You’re the Ancient of Days
The Rock on which I’m standing
You are worthy of my praise

Chorus

Blessed be (2x)
Blessed be Your Name
Blessed be(2x)
Blessed be Your Name

And You Oh! Lord,
Are the Deep that I have searched for
The Ever Flowing Fountain
That my heart always thirst for
You’re the One who makes me whole,
You’re the Lover of my soul
And whatever comes my way,
I know You’re in control

BRIDGE:
Let Your people proclaim
You are Holy, You are Holy God
And we lift up Your Name and give glory
Glory to Your Name

title: HALLELUYAH! HALLELUYAH!! HALLELUYAH!!!
THIS IS JUST WHAT HEAVEN MEANS TO ME
lyrics:
A country where no twilight shadows deepen,
Unending day where night shall never be;
A City where no storm clouds ever gather,
Oh! This is just what heaven means to me.

Chorus

What will it be when we get over yonder,
And join the throng upon the Glassy Sea!
We’ll greet our loved ones and crown Christ forever,
Oh! This is just what heaven means to me.

A place where there is no mis-under-standing,
And from all enmity and strife we’re free;
No unkind words to wound the heart are spoken,
Now this is just what Heaven means to me.

And when at last we see the face of Jesus,
Before whose image other loves all cease;
And when they crown Him Lord of all, I’ll be there,
Oh! This is just what Heaven means to me.

title: NO OTHER WORD FOR GRACE BUT AMAZING
lyrics:
Red can’t explain the beauty of a rose
White can’t tell, the magic in the air when it snows
Marvellous can’t half convey the Grace of the King
No other word for grace but amazing.

Chorus

There’s no other word
For grace but amazing
No other explanation would do
Unmerited favour, the song that I sing
No other word for grace but amazing

My Father looked beyond
All the failures I have made
He didn’t notice all those times
That I have not obeyed and
He overlooked all the scars of sin I held in me
But the grace that He shows, it still amazes

title: HE DIED FOR ME
lyrics:
Broken, mocked and scorned,
Was the Man hanging from the Cross,
With a crown of thorns ,Who is He,
This Man who died for me,
This given Son, Who was born to die
So we could be redeemed.

Chorus

He died for you, He died for me
He took my pains
And He bore my shame
That day on Calvary,
The Bleeding Word (One)
God’s only Son,
What kind of Man is this
Who'd walk this road alone J-e-s-u-s.

It was suppose to be me,
Hanging from that tree,
It was my sins that crucified Him,
I don’t deserve any mercy,
But as we come to You today,
We remember what You gave
Lord through this Bleeding Word
You have revealed to us our name.

title: THE PIERCING OF THE THORN
lyrics:
You may think that I’ve always been happy,
And I wish I could say I've always been,
But it hasn’t always been a bed of roses,
I've experienced a thorn now and then

Chorus

Now and then
I felt the piercing of the thorn,
And some where deeper than
Other times before,
But there’s no disgrace, you see,
Jesus knows what’s best for me,
Through the piercing I'm a better man

When we're weak
God’s strength makes us strong,
When it seems like everything
Has turn out wrong,
There’s a thorn but there’s a Rose
That’s always there,
Always there to show His tender loving care

title: I KNOW MY REDEEMER LIVES
lyrics:
Who taught the sun
Where to stand in the morning,
(And) Who told the ocean
You can only come this far,
And who showed the moon,
Where to hide till evening,
Whose words alone
Can catch a falling star.

Chorus

I know my Redeemer lives,
I know my Redeemer lives,
All of creation testifies,
This life within me cries
I know my Redeemer lives

The very same God that spin
Things in orbit, runs to the weary,
The worn, and the weak,
And the same gentle hands
That hold me when I’m broken,
They conquer death to bring me victory.

title: CONSIDER THE LILIES
lyrics:
Consider the lilies,
They don’t toil nor spin
But there’s not a king
With more splendor than they
Consider the sparrows
They don’t plant nor sow
But they are fed by the Master
Who watches them grow

Chorus

And we have a Heavenly Father above
With eyes full of mercy and
Heart filled with love
And He really cares
When your head is bowed low
Consider the lilies and
Then you will know

May I introduce you
To this friend of mine
Who hangs out the stars;
And tells the sun when to shine
And kisses the flowers
Each morning with dew
But He’s not too busy to care about you.

title: BE UNTO ME ACCORDING TO THY WORD
lyrics:
Be it unto me
According to Your word,
According to Your promises,
I can stand secure.
Carve upon my heart
The truth that sets me free,
According to Your word, Oh! Lord,
Be it unto me.

You promised
Your blood would deliver,
Lord, we believe it’s true.
You promised us joy like a river.
Lord, we receive it from You.
These things You have spoken,
You’re bringing to pass.
This world’s disappearing,
But Your word will last.

You promised to carry our sorrow,
Lord, we believe it’s true.
You promised unending tomorrows,
Lord, we receive it from You.
You will be our provider,
In Your word it’s revealed,
And by the stripes that You bore,
We have been healed.

title: LORD HELP ME RUN IN THE RACE
lyrics:
Sometimes the way
Down here gets rough,
When I look at Satan's bluff,
It’s then I’ll rise on the wings of faith,
For in God’s word, I am safe.

Chorus

Lord help me run in the race
Help me not bring You disgrace
But let me rise on the wings of faith
Until the day I see Your face.

Now we can see the ending sign
The coming of the Lord is nigh
Oh! Sinner where will you stand
When the time down here will end

title: THE SAME GOD
lyrics:
I look back on history
And see the Mighty God unveiled
Proving over and over
That His Word has never failed
But I can’t keep on dwelling
On some past memories
‘Cause now the same God
Is living in me.

Chorus

The same God Who spoke to
The woman at the well
He's the same God Whose wonders
Are too many to tell
The same God Who parted
The raging Red Sea
Is the same God
Who’s living in me.

The same God Who created
All the heavens and all the earth
Came back living in Jesus
And there was power in His Word
And now in these last days
I’m beginning to see
That it’s that same God
Who’s living in me

title: PRISONER’S CHAINS
lyrics:
In prisoner’s chains
With bleeding stripes
Paul and Silas prayed that night
And in their pains began to sing
Their chains were loosed
And they were free

Chorus

I bless Your Name(2x
I give You honour, give You praise
You are the Life, the Truth, the Way,
I bless Your Name (2x)

In some midnight hour
If you should find
Your inner prison in your mind
Reach out and press
To fight those chains
And they will fall in Jesus’ Name

title: WINDS OF FAITH
lyrics:
There are two roads you may take
One by sight and one by faith
Take the Word of God
Or what you see
What you believe is what will be

Chorus

Set your wings to the winds of faith
You can fly in a higher place
Do not struggle it’s by grace
Set your wings to the winds of faith

What’s your need and what’s your cry?
What’s your mountain, much too high?
Speak the word of God and by and by
It will move or you will fly

Watch the eagle in the sky
He does not struggle,
He does not strive
For the power that makes him rise
Is already in the sky.

title: I WANT, WHAT YOU WANT FOR ME
lyrics:
I want what You want for me, Dear Lord,
Whatever, where ever, it may be,
Cause I know, that You know
What’s best my Lord (for me)
And I want what You want
For me, Yes! Lord
I want what You want for me.

title: IF WE WALK IN THE LIGHT
lyrics:
If we walk in the light, As He is in the light
We have fellowship one with another
And the Blood of Jesus Christ
His Son cleansed us from all sin,
If we walk in the light.

title: DAYS OF ELIJAH
lyrics:
These are the days of Elijah
Declaring the word of the Lord
This is the day of His promise
Righteousness being restored
And though these are days of great trials
Of famine and darkness and sword
Still we are the voice
In the last day crying
Prepare ye the way of the Lord

Chorus

Behold He comes riding on the clouds
Shining like the sun at the trumpet call
Lift your voice, It‘s the year of Jubilee
Out of Zion’s Hill salvation comes

And these are the days of Ezekiel
The dry bones becoming as flesh
And these are the days
Of Your servant David
Rebuilding the temple of praise
And these are the days of the harvest
The fields are white in the world
And we are Your labourers
In Your Vineyard
Declaring the Word of the Lord

title: LET THE RAIN COME DOWN
lyrics:
We are living in these last days,
In a harassing and a thirsty age
God sent Elijah, His prophet again
That He might come to us
And bring the rain.

Chorus

Let the rain come down,
Let the thunder roll,
Filling me up, let me overflow
Till I can take no more;
Filling me up, let me overflow
Till I can take no more.

When you are a seed of God,
You’ve got to be planted
In the Word to die;
Your body might decay here
In the earth, but it will spring
To life with eternal growth.

title: I JUST WANT TO SAY THANK YOU LORD
lyrics:
Lord I didn’t come here
To ask You for anything
But Lord I just want to say, thank You Lord
You answered a million prayers, O! God
That I forgot to thank You for
So I just want to say thank You, Lord

Chorus

For maybe tomorrow,
I’ll have troubles, trials and sorrows
And a thousand tears,
They may fall, Heavenly Father
O! But until I face tomorrow’s test,
I have no special favours to ask
Lord I just want to say, thank You Lord

You’ve been so good,
My Lord You’ve been so kind
I’m so grateful Lord, I’m so grateful Father
You’ve kept us in our right minds
Many times we don’t know what to do
But You’ve always, brought us through
We come today, Lord, We come today
Father, just to say thank You Lord

You gave us eyes to see
When we were bound, You set us free
We can’t forget Lord, all of the things
That You have done
O! Lord we travelled by land,
And we travelled by air
I know You kept us Lord,
Kept us from harm, hurt and danger

title: JESUS BE JESUS IN ME
lyrics:
Jesus be Jesus in me
No longer me but Thee
Resurrection power, fill me this hour
Jesus be The Word (Jesus) in me

title: I WILL LIFT UP HIS NAME HIGHER
lyrics:
I will lift up Your (His) Name higher
I will lift up Your (His) Name higher
Oh! Jehovah, Alpha & Omega
I will lift up Your (His) Name higher

title: WE HAVE A MESSAGE
lyrics:
Moses told the children of Israel
"The Lord shall raise up a prophet
Like unto me and Him shall ye hear"
Truly Jesus came fulfilling
All that Moses said, then died and rose
And gave us salvation to declare

Chorus

We have a Message to the world
We have a Message to save lost souls
We have a Message to the sick and dying
We’ve got to tell you Jesus saves
We’ve got to tell you Jesus heals
We have a Message that makes
Your life worth living

Surely the Lord God will do nothing
But He reveal His Secrets to the prophets
Like the one He has sent in our day
He fulfilled Revelation 10 and 7, Malachi 4:5 and 6
We now have this Seven Seal Message to declare

Chorus

We have a Message to declare
We have a Message the end is near
We have a Message to those souls
That are thirsting
What for ages has been sealed
In our day has been revealed
This is what has made
Our lives worth living

title: SOMETIMES HALLELUYAH
lyrics:
Sometimes Halleluyah
Sometimes praise the Lord
Sometimes gently singing
Our hearts in one accord

title: FIRE, FIRE, FALL ON ME
lyrics:
Fire, fire, fire, fire, Fire fall on me } 2x
Just like the day of Pentecost, Fire fall on me } 2x

title: LIVING EPISTLES
lyrics:
We are eyewitnesses of His Majesty,
We have seen the Lord fulfilling His Word;
And we know we are God’s characters
In this Great Symphony,
As we act on the things that
We have seen and we have heard.

Chorus

How else can we live,
Forever praising Him,
For we are living epistles read of all men;
(You are) Almighty God in flesh again,
(That’s who you are,)
Living epistles read of all men,
Almighty God in flesh again.

We’ve been made a spectacle
To this world today,
The Life of Jesus be on display;
Our resurrected Christ.
Awaken Jesus to the scene again,
As He glorifies His Name
Once again in His children.

We know that today
The Word is in the Bride
It’s Jesus fulfilling
His Second fold purpose
So ride on Thy Majesty
To Thy rightful place
To the throne of our hearts
Of Your Kingdom,
We are so glad to be a part.

Let's press on daily with
The King's sword in our hands
Defeating the enemy on every hand
Let's bring our King, our rejected King,
A clean fresh water
By life worthy of this gospel,
We'll worship Him

title: HE’S ALREADY PROVIDED
lyrics:
He’s already provided (2x)
Everything I (you) need
He’s already provided
Every promise that I (you) need
Ask Him in His Name
Everything I (you) need
He’s already provided

title: COME WHAT MAY
lyrics:
He didn’t say that it was going to be easy;
Every promise my Lord has made
We’ve got to fight to claim.
For as many as He called,
He gave the power to overcome;
And every devil that stands before us
Must be on the run!
So why should I ever think it
Strange when fiery trials should, come my way?
For He said, that if I do suffer for His Name,
Lord, with You I shall reign.

Chorus

Come what may,
With Your Word I will stay,
Come what may,
I’ll press through anyway;
Come what may, Lord have Your way.

I’ll consider Him Who for the joy
That was set before Him, the Cross He endured
And that same life now dwelleth within me
Victory I’m assured for He did say,
He’ll never leave me nor forsake me,
And as a Seed of Abraham
I’ll possess the gates of my enemies!
Why should I ever think it strange
When fiery trials should, come my way?
For He said that if I do suffer
For His Name, with Him I shall reign.

As I journey along, may Lord,
I ever be, courageous and strong;
For inch by inch I’ll possess the land
For I’m a journeyman,
By striving lawfully, knowing
Thou savourest reverence and humility;
Let the fullness of that meal offering
Be displayed in me!
I should never ever think it strange
When fiery trials should come my way,
For You said that if, I do suffer for Your Name,
With You I shall reign.

title: STILL SMALL VOICE
lyrics:
We’ve heard Elijah on the Mount
Ran from the wrath of Jezebel
But God came down to visit him
And caused his heart to swell
In a wind, earthquake and fire
God came to him by choice
But he bowed his head in reverence
To the Still Small Voice

Chorus

I thank the Lord for coming today
In a still small voice
Raise your hand my brother and sister,
Let’s stand and rejoice
Overlook the wind, the thunder and fire
And wait on the Lord
Let’s put our faith in the glorious Grace
Of His still, small voice

This world has been conditioned
To think the power of the Lord
Only comes through great convictions
With miracles galore
But in this age of mixed emotions
There's a word that's being voiced
Not in the miracles, signs and wonders,
But in a still, small voice

This Church has been commissioned
To spread the gospel far and wide
For Christ our Lord will come again
To catch away His bride
Striving for perfection,
Filled with the Holy Ghost
We are called unto adoption
By the still, small voice

title: JESUS DRAW ME CLOSE
lyrics:
Jesus draw me close
Closer Lord to Thee
Let the world around me fade away
Jesus draw me close
Closer Lord to Thee
(For) I desire to reflect You alone
[(For) I desire to obey all Your word]
[(For) I desire to worship and obey]

title: COMFORT OF MY SOUL
lyrics:
When I remember the time
I was so low in sin,
Dear Jesus, You came
And showed me Your Grace
Now no one could ever
Take me from Your hand,
And now I can never be the same
For now I live only for You
By Your Grace.

Chorus

For Jesus is all I have to live for,
Jesus You're my Truest friend
That I can ever lean on,
He can be trusted and
His word can never fail,
He is the Comfort of my soul.( 2x)

Sometimes I get weak and can’t go on,
But Dear Jesus You're there
To make me strong,
And though I am tempted,
You are my shield;
Oh! Lord, You have shown me such love,
All I have I surrender to You

title: RESTORE TO ME THE JOY
lyrics:
I seem to lose the strength
I’ve had before
I need the leadership
Of Your Spirit even more
Oh! Lord You know I feel alone
I don’t ever want to be
On my own, anymore
And yet I know that something lies ahead
And if I yield to the Spirit I’ll be led
Within the perfect plan of God
In His glory I will trod, for evermore

Chorus

Restore to me the joy of Thy salvation
Reveal to me the secrets of Your heart
If I could learn to understand Thee
I’d see how great Thou art

title: BLESSED ARE YOU
lyrics:
Like the hart pursued by its evil foe,
It knows well to stay near that brook
Where the waters flow;
So panteth my soul after You,
The Living Word,
I know well to stay near that river
Where Living Waters flow.

Chorus

Blessed are you
Who hunger and thirst after righteousness,
Blessed are you, for you shall be filled;
Blessed are you when men persecute you
For My Name’s sake, you see;
Blessed are you (3x)

Where there is a deep,
There is a deep to respond;
For unto this end were you born
To be a child of God, a child of I AM,
Know that the Great I AM now dwelleth within
And soon through you, He’ll display
He’s just the same Today
As He was Yesterday.

In the midst of the night,
We saw an Amber-Coloured Light,
The Light of Yellowish Green
Is Jesus on the scene
Come to lead His elected genes;
Beyond the riven veil,
On peaceful waters the ship now sails,
No more tossed to and fro
By stormy winds that blow,
He has anchored our souls.

title: WE ARE ALREADY IN THE RAPTURE
lyrics:
We are already in the Rapture
We are already in the footstep
By the signs of the Message of the Hour
We are already in the Rapture

title: GOING BACK TO THE FAITH
lyrics:
This is the age Malachi 4:5 is fulfilled,
God sent a prophet in this time, for this age;
Despised and rejected by denomination,
Yet God had a people on the earth
To hear his voice;
Out there I was in Egypt land,
God called me out by His command,
The way He did with Abraham.

Chorus

We’re going back to the Faith,
The Faith of our forefathers,
We’re going back to the Faith
Where we’ll die for eternal life;
We’re going back to the Faith
Into the Garden of Eden,
We’re going back to the Faith,
Where we know
We were predestinated,
Before the foundation of the world
To walk by Faith.

This is the age of Lao-dicea,
Where men and women
Fight for their rights, (For their rights),
False doctrines and creeds
Feel welcome in this world,
For this is the age Satan sits
On his throne, (On his throne)
Where Jezebel and her harlots celebrate,
Where many are drunken from her wine;
And this is the age where
The mysteries go back to the East,
Saints, this is the end of the Gentiles’ time,
Make sure you don’t get left behind.

title: GLORIFY THY NAME
lyrics:
Father! We love You,
We worship and adore You.
Glorify Thy Name in all the Earth.

Chorus

Glorify Thy Name (3x).
In all the Earth.

title: GREATER WORKS
lyrics:
For we are partakers,
Lord of Your Holiness,
And we are now clothed
In Your righteousness;
And we are Your children
Walking in this Evening Light,
And in Your Bride You’ll be glorified.

Chorus

Greater works than these shall you do,
For it’s a promise for me and you.
Greater works than these shall you do,
For it’s a promise for me and you.

For the God of Peace shall bruise
Satan soon under our feet,
The army of the living God,
He shall not defeat;
So brothers let's praise God
For this mighty privilege
To be a part of this Apostolic heritage.

For the cup of the iniquity
Of this world is almost full,
And here we are upon Mt. Zion
Awaiting that final pull;
May God grant us the faith
To use that two-edged Sword,
For every day Your elect cries,
“Just once more Lord.”

So brothers and sisters
Let’s keep on abiding in His Word;
Don’t look to the things of this world
And get your vision blurred;
For we’ve been drawn to that Holy place
Where Our Lord has placed His Name;
Having blessed assurance
He’ll glorify it again.

title: MY LORD DELIVERED ME
lyrics:
My Lord delivered me with His Mighty hand,
My Lord delivered me from the sinking sand.
My Lord delivered me, that is why I sing,
My Lord delivered me I could never stop praising Him

title: LET US DRAW NEAR
lyrics:
Are we weak and troubled
Or in deep despair?
Is the avenger of our souls on our trail?
Well, the Name of our Lord
Is a Mighty Tower
That the righteous can run
Into and be safe.

Chorus

Let us draw near with a true heart
In full assurance of faith;
That we may find grace and strength
To help in a time of need.

It took a perfect sacrifice before
We could ever attain to perfect faith;
That’s why Christ the perfect Lamb,
The Atonement came,
And to the Holiest of Holies,
He cleared the way.

We were not made like angels,
We’re of human kind,
And we daily make mistakes
For we are weak,
But we have a High Priest
Who can be touched
With the feelings of our infirmities.

Chorus

So let us draw near
Having our hearts
Sprinkled by His blood
For now we have free access
To the throne of God

title: I FEEL GOOD, GOOD, GOOD
lyrics:
I feel good, good, good
I feel good about His wonderful grace
Anytime they talk about Jesus
I feel good, good, good

title: GOD IS GOD
lyrics:
God is God, God is no man
God is God, God is no man
God is God, God is no man
He can do it again
(He has done it again)

title: JEHOVAH NISSI
lyrics:
Men have built their empires
On scientific exploits
Towers of organizations will reap
The fruits of their vain toils.
But men of war let’s draw near,
United under one headship,
We’ve seen the vision
And we’re committed
Let’s possess the gates
Of the enemy without fear.

Chorus

He shall go before us
Set fire to the camp of the enemies
Jehovah Nissi, God our banner
Will cleanse this world from iniquity
The Lord shall roar from Zion
That heavenly Jerusalem
And though the heavens and earth will shake
The Lord will be His people’s hope and strength

False anointed ones in the end time,
Appear to be all clothed in white
Try to paint a picture of perfection
To deceive the true vine,
But we as the army of the Living God,
We see through eyes of the eagles,
We’ll fight the good fight
And keep the faith
If God be for us then tell me
Who can be against us.

title: THE GOD OF BRANHAM
lyrics:
Praise the Lord,
The God of Branham is still alive
Praise the Lord
He never changes always the same

title: WHAT SHALL I RENDER
lyrics:
What shall I render? What shall I render?
What shall I render to Thee oh! Lord?
I will praise Thee Lord!
And shout Halleluyah!
What shall I render to Thee Oh! Lord?

title: ISAAC’S BRIDE
lyrics:
The last message has come and gone,
This Word has swept
The face of the whole earth,
And there are many who have heard it;
But out of these there shines a Bride,
The chosen ones,
The precious Seed of God,
She’s the Rebecca for her Isaac;
And one of these days
She will be changed,
She’ll slip from time into eternity.

While people laugh at us and mock,
Our lives are being
Raptured up with Him,
We know He has received us;
And we’ll come forth in His image,
The chosen ones,
The elected Seed of God,
The ones who love and serve Him;
And one of these days
We will be changed,
We’ll slip from time into eternity.

He will return just as He said,
To take His Bride away to be with Him,
In His great Millennium;
His promise is true; He has returned,
He never breaks or fails
To keep His Word;
Just let us all be ready,
For one of these days
We’ll all be changed,
We’ll slip from time into eternity.

title: HE CAN NEVER EVER FAIL
lyrics:
He can never ever fail (3x)
Jesus the same forever.

title: WONDERFUL AND MARVELLOUS
lyrics:
Wonderful and marvellous
Is Jesus to me,
Sweeter than the honey
In the honeycomb is He,
Jesus is real, He will never fail,
I will praise Him now
And throughout all Eternity (2x)

title: IN THE BEGINNING
lyrics:
He had in His mind
Before the foundation,
That He, the Lamb would be slain
To redeem His creation;
He knew we had fallen
From our lofty heights to sin,
So He had to come in flesh and die,
To bring us back again to Eden.

Chorus

In the beginning, before the beginning,
The Great Elohim, had no origin,
He had no father, no mother,
The Great Jehovah our God.

He came with a Shout
Revealing His redemption,
To call and claim His Bride
From the powers of deception;
So why should we doubt
That His words are in our mouths,
For He has ordained that
We must prophesy again,
To every nation.

We have crossed back
The chasm to our lofty heights,
By Seven Thundering Voices,
His Great Evening Light;
We’ll be translated
To His heavenly domain,
We’ll sit with Him as priests and kings;
We will reign with Him.
Forever and ever and ever.

title: MY LORD DELIVERED DANIEL
lyrics:
My Lord delivered Daniel (3x)
My Lord delivers me

title: THANK YOU LORD FOR HOLDING ME
lyrics:
Thank You Lord for holding, holding me
If not for You Lord Tell me where I’ll be?
In Your arms I found
There is a sweet stability
Thank You Lord for holding, holding me

title: GOD’S EAGLES
lyrics:
I lived in a world of sin and shame
That only caused me grief and pain,
And I tried so hard to be free,
Searching for my true identity,
Didn’t know I came from eternity,
Until God came and revealed it to me.

Chorus

On the wings of a snow-white Dove,
God sent His pure sweet love,
On the wings of a snow-white Dove
To take His eagle home. (2x)

I knew somehow I was born
To fly way up in the sky,
But somehow I couldn’t
Set my wings free;
But since that day I heard His voice
And made Him my heavenly choice,
By His grace I can say I’ve been set free.

Now behold what manner of love
The Father hath bestowed upon us,
That we might be called the Sons of God!
Wherever He bids us we will go,
Wherever He leads we will follow,
’Cause who the Son has set free is free indeed

title: I CANNOT FAIL THE LORD
lyrics:
The Lord of my life
He has never failed
On my own I could never succeed
This one I’ve come to know
There’s so much I owe
And I cannot fail, the Lord

Chorus

I cannot fail the Lord (2x)
He has never failed me yet
Every promise He has kept
And I cannot fail the Lord

And things, when they are done
In His Name are won
In the past, I didn’t trust God
I trusted in myself
Now I know I have His help
And I cannot fail the Lord.

title: YOURS FOREVER
lyrics:
I wrote a letter to my Lord
I didn’t know where to start
I told Him of the happiness
That swelled within my heart
I thanked Him for the love inside
That I didn’t have before
And at the end, I signed it
I’ll be Yours forever

Chorus

I want to be Yours forever,
Yours forever, Lord I want
To be Yours forever
Yours forever, Yours forever,
Yours forevermore

A few days later in Sunday School
We learned John 3:16
It told of everlasting life
If only we’d believe
Now everlasting means forever
And I began to see God’s Word
Is a letter to my heart,
He’s written back to me

title: COME BY HERE MY LORD
lyrics:
Come by here my Lord
Come by here
Come by here my Lord
Come by here
Come by here my Lord
Come by here
Oh! Lord come by here

Speak to me my Lord
Come by here
Speak to me my Lord
Come by here
Speak to me my Lord
Come by here
Oh! Lord come by here

I am listening Lord
Come by here
I am listening Lord
Come by here
I am listening Lord
Come by here
Oh! Lord come by here

title: FULL REDEMPTION
lyrics:
Lord! With one foot on land
And one foot on sea
You brought Redemption for me
I was lost and undone
But thank God that Your grace
Has indeed really found me
And You gave to me
Eye salve that I may see
How great You are, and what
You’ve made me to be

Chorus

Full redemption
I found grace in a time of judgment
