The stone that the builders rejected
Has become the Chief Stone of my life
For He has gone to prepare a place
That where He is I’ll be there
For all eternity.

I see a world held in darkness
O! There is so much evil all around me
But Lord with You I am standing
For I know that soon Your Kingdom
Will be ushered in, continue to break
Every kingdom in my heart
Till I only be Your Living Word manifested

title: LET THE SON SHINE
lyrics:
There’s a little life inside
The seed of God
And in the Son it will spring up
From the sod
It is the rising of the sun
And I can feel His power to press on

Chorus

Let the SON shine down on me
‘Till the radiance of Your word, In me I see
In Your light, all darkness flees
Let the SON shine down on me

In the presence of the Son of Man
We can grow in the image of I AM
There’ll be light about the evening time
Calling, “Bride come up hither,
RISE AND SHINE"

title: SPECIAL MOUNTAIN
lyrics:
I long to see Jesus,
Just a glimpse of Him cannot satisfy
I just want to love Him,
Till all the fears in me completely subside.

Chorus

For there’s just something
Special about that mountain,
Though many valleys to cross
He’s more than worth the pain,
There’s just something
Special about that mountain,
I’m just ready to fight
One more time again.

I long for deeper fellowship
With the One Who has chosen
Me to bear His Name.
I just want to be faithful,
Just to love and serve Him
Again and again.

I long for the fullness of Eternal Life
To share a glory that will never fade away;
And I long for my precious new body
Where no sickness or pain
Would ever be again.

title: ALL THAT REALLY COUNTS
lyrics:
Solomon concluded, “All is vanity,”
Now my heart believes that it is true
Took me all this time to find reality
All I ever really want is You

Chorus

All that really counts
All that is really true
All that really matters Lord is You
Everything to gain
Nothing now to lose
All I ever really want is You

So take the grandest thing
You know that life can give
Weigh it with eternity’s bright side
One thing I have learnt
In all this life I live,
There is truly nothing good but God.

title: JESUS WANT YOU TO BELIEVE
lyrics:
Who do you feel at the preaching,
Of the word?
Does something beckon you,
To live what you’ve heard?
Has Satan told you that,
You cannot live right?
And that never, no never,
Will you win the fight

Chorus

But Jesus wants you to believe (Right now)
So that you can receive (Oh! Yes)
But Jesus wants you to believe (Right now)
So that you can receive (Oh! Yes)

How do feel when the Holy Spirit falls?
Does something beckon you,
To answer the call?
Has Satan told you that,
You still want to sin?
And that never no never,
Will you have it within?

The greatest lie is true
Ninety-nine percent
And Satan is honest when he says
That you’ve sinned
But that little one percent is so untrue
For he’ll never admit that,
God’s forgiven you

title: IMPOSSIBLE WILL BE POSSIBLE
lyrics:
Impossible will be possible
The quickening power is here
“Only believe” The prophet stressed
And all things shall be possible.

title: COME SOFTEN MY HEART
lyrics:
Come soften my heart
Come soften my heart
From all indifference
And set me apart
To feel Your compassion
Just weep with Your tears
Come soften my heart, oh! Lord
Soften my heart.

title: I’D LIKE TO TALK IT OVER
lyrics:
Some morning when I stand in
God’s wonderful city,
Where the light of that City
Will never grow dim
And I shake hands with my loved ones
Who've gone on before
I’d like to talk it over with Him.

Chorus

I’d like to kneel down,
And talk it all over with Him,
I’d like to say, Lord,
You loved me, when my path was so dim,
I cannot repay Him
When I meet Him, in that City above,
But I’d like to talk it over,
And I thank Him, for His wonderful love.

We’ll be singing, “Hallelujahs,"
Forever and forever,
For we’re told, the cup of gladness,
He’ll fill to the brim,
But I know that, I have brought Him,
Some deep tears of sorrow,
And I’d like to talk it over with Him.

With so many redeemed ones
I'm sure I'll be happy
They said the cup of gladness
He'll fill to the brim
But I know that I've caused Him
Many deep tears of sorrow
Oh! I'd like to talk it over with Him

title: PRAISE THE LORD HALLELUYAH
lyrics:
Praise the Lord, Halleluyah
I don‘t care what the devil’s gonna do
The Word of God is my strength and shield
Jesus is the Lord of the way I feel.

title: I AM SO NEEDY LORD
lyrics:
I am so need Lord, so needy of You
I am so needy Lord, to be more like Thee
Shear all my rights away, In this world of sin
I am so needy Lord, make me pure within

title: RUNNING MY LAST MILE HOME
lyrics:
Here I stand at the crossing of the river
Well I've lived a lifetime for this day alone,
Well I just saw the light
And I'm getting a little bit anxious
Well I started out a walking
But I'm running my last mile home.

Chorus

Ring the bell, blow the horn, Shout! Hallelujah
Jordan roll on back and let me through
Angels take me to the throne
Little David play your prettiest music
For a weary pilgrim
I'm running my last mile home

Well! I’ve met with many
A crossroads on my journey
But never once has my God let me roam
Well! the deserts and the valleys lie behind me
Well! The road is strait,
And I'm running my last mile home.

Now heaven's claimed
So many smiling faces
Till I don’t feel at home anymore
Well I just heard sounds
Of old familiar voices
They’re singing a new song
I’ve never heard before

title: I WILL PRAISE THE LORD THE DEVIL CANNOT STOP ME
lyrics:
I will praise the Lord,
The devil cannot stop me
I will praise my God, in all situations
In the prison yard, in the wilderness
I will praise my God,
For His faithfulness I will praise the Lord
For His faithfulness I will praise the Lord

title: CANAAN’S LAND IS JUST IN SIGHT
lyrics:
Moses led God’s children
Forty years he led them
Through the cold and through the night
Though they said "Let’s turn back,"
Moses said, "Keep going"
Canaan’s land is just in sight

Chorus

There will be no sorrow
There in that tomorrow
We will be there by and by
Milk and honey is flowing
That is where I’m going
Canaan’s land is just in sight

Though we walk through valleys,
Though we climb high mountains
We can not give up the fight.
We must be like Moses
We must keep on going
Canaan’s land is just in sight.

title: LET ME FEEL YOUR SPIRIT
lyrics:
Lord, I’ve been busy here and there
Till life’s burden and its trials have
Grounded out my prayer
But now I find I’m empty Lord
I would You let me feel Your Spirit
In my heart again

Chorus

Lord! I need to feel Your power
And joy down in my soul
And a sweet peace that only comes
When Jesus has control
I don’t want to walk this road
Lord I know where it ends
Would You let me feel Your Spirit
In my heart again?

Lord, I remember sweet victory in soul
And the close, sweet fellowship we had
Makes joyful rivers flow
I know I’ve been neglectful, Lord
But You know where I’ve been.
Would You let me feel Your Spirit
In my heart again.

title: ANYBODY KNOW
lyrics:
When I was searching
He sought me out
He gave me answers
Took away my doubts
When I was struggling,
To find my place
I heard the sweetest song
Sent to me from the throne
A song of love and g-r-a-c-e

Chorus

If anybody knows
About the love of Jesus
I do, I do-oh!...
Anybody knows about the love of Jesus
I do, Yes! I do

(If anybody knows about the grace of Jesus)
(If anybody knows about the power of Jesus)

title: THE PENTECOSTAL POWER
lyrics:
The power, the power,
The Pentecostal Power,
Is just the same today,
No matter what they say
The power, the power,
The Pentecostal power
It is just the same today.

title: AS THE DEER PANTETH FOR THE WATERS
lyrics:
As the deer panteth for the waters
So my soul longeth after Thee
You alone are my heart’s desire
And I long to worship Thee

Chorus

You alone are my Strength and Shield
To You alone let my spirit yield
You alone are my heart's desire,
And I long to worship Thee.

You're my friend, and You are my brother
Even though You are my King
I want You more than any other
So much more than anything.

title: TEARS WILL NEVER STAIN
lyrics:
If I could count all the tears
That have fallen
It would seem like an ocean to me
If my heart were a window
You could look through
All the pain and scars you will see.

Chorus

Tears will never stain, the streets of that City
No wreaths of death, on my mansion door
Tear drops aren't welcome beyond the gates of Glory
Because the heart will never break anymore.

I have questioned the loss of a loved one
The grave seem so final and cold
But we'll meet again where death has no victory
In a land where we will never grow old

I’ve never met one man without sorrow
Never looked into eyes with no pain
But there's a land where grief is a stranger
And joy is the only song they sing.

title: I CAME TO WORSHIP YOU
lyrics:
I came to worship You.
I came to seek Your face
I came to love You Lord
Your Holy Name to praise
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Oh! How I worship You
You’re my Lord.

title: WE ARE THE CHILDREN OF GOD
lyrics:
(We are the children of God
We came from God
We’re going to God, Hallelujah) 2x
Singing Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah

title: I KNOW MY LORD IS GOING TO LEAD ME OUT
lyrics:
I‘m pressing on, through the world of cares,
Nobody knows, what a load I bear,
But for my Lord, I’ll bravely stand
I know my Lord is going to lead me out
Of this pilgrim land.

I know my Lord is going to lead me out
I know my Lord is going to lead me out
I‘m going to pray (I’ll keep praying)
Do the best I can
I know my Lord is going to lead me out
Of this pilgrim land

I‘m going to lean
On the Message way (Gospel way)
Just long enough, to kneel and pray,
I’m going to clinch, to his precious Hand,
I know my Lord is going to lead me out
Of this pilgrim land.

title: THERE’S A GREAT MAGNET
lyrics:
I’m getting weary of this
Lonesome road I've trod
Everyday I’m longing more
To be with God
Just to leave this world
Of sin and all its strife
And to walk into a heavenly new life

Chorus

There’s a great magnet
Drawing from above
And there’s nothing
Can hold me here below
I'll rise to meet Him in the air
When the final call comes for me to go

As I gaze into the starry sky above
How I marvel at the mighty work of God
Just to know He’s living in my soul
It’s the greatest gift any man could hold

title: I AM REDEEMED
lyrics:
I am redeemed
I’m bought with a price,
Jesus has changed my whole life,
If any body ask you,
Just who I am?
Tell them I am redeemed

title: THAT’S WHY I CALL HIM LORD
lyrics:
I was taken from His side
When my Lord bled and died,
The earth shook,
And all of nature’s pillars cried.
On that sad and mournful day,
The sun went down and hid away,
When by blood, Jehovah-God
Purchased His Bride.

Chorus

That’s why I call Him Lord,
Lord Jesus Christ,
Yes! I call Him Lord Jesus Christ.
I’m a new creation, I’m His flesh,
I’m His spirit, I’m His bone,
And I’ll tell the world He’s Lord,
And we two are one.

Several times I’ve let Him down,
But my slide made His love more strong,
From His side flowed reconciling love,
Such a Love the world don’t know;
Such a Love it could never show;
It took the Dove to bring it
Down from up above.

For a sign, just to show the world,
That my gene was celestial,
From His side, royal blood did flow
Oh! The serpent’s head was crushed well done,
Hallelujah to God’s Holy One!
Who by His blood has brought me
Back to my God.

title: I'M RUNNING
lyrics:
I'm running, I'm running
My running days will soon be over
I’m running, I got to get in a hurry
I know I’m going to make it to the other side.

title: SAVED BY GRACE
lyrics:
Saved by grace,
I‘ve been saved by grace,
My name is in the Book of Life
And my sin‘s are washed away,
Saved by grace,
I’ve been saved by grace,
It‘s not what I deserved
But I’m saved by grace

title: MY TENT IS NO MORE PITCHED
lyrics:
My tent is no more pitched
Down there in Egypt‘s land
You‘ll see me no more there
I (now) live in another land
Halleluyah, Halleluyah (2x)

My tent is no more pitched
Down there in Laodicea
You‘ll see me no more there
I (now) live in the Bride age
Halleluyah, Halleluyah (2x)

My tent is no more pitched
Down there in Moab land
You‘ll see me no more there
I (now) live in Bethlehem
Halleluyah, Halleluyah (2x)

title: GOD WILL MAKE A WAY
lyrics:
God will make a way,
Where there seems to be no way
Forever He is faithful
(And) He will make a road
When you bear a heavy load
I Know (Just know)
God will make a way

title: SPIRIT OF GOD MOVE
lyrics:
Spirit of God move,
Write Your word in my heart
Fill my whole being
Consume my life,
Spirit of God move
An empty vessel I want to be
So that You can come,
Lord and fill me.

title: PEACE LIKE A RIVER
lyrics:
Peace like a river
Love like a mountain
The wind of Your Spirit
Is blowing everywhere
Joy like a fountain
Healing stream of life
Come Holy Spirit
Let Your fire fall.

title: I DO BELIEVE
lyrics:
Just follow the strait way
And the path that leads to God
And then don't look back
The sinful path you've trod,
And though Satan may tempt you,
Run to that shelter in the Lord Jesus Christ.

Chorus

I do believe that His coming is at hand
Yes, I believe that we're at the very end,
And if you knew the Lord
Was coming tomorrow,
Live a Christian life,
Try to win some souls today.

Don't lay down your armour
You must press the battle each day
And for this End Time Message
There's a price you have to pay,
The Bride may suffer Persecution
But Tribulation she will never see.

The world is in darkness
Gross darkness all around
But there is a MAN here,
Who can turn on the LIGHT
Shalom to the Little Bride,
Arise and shine, for thy light has come.

title: HIS NAME IS HIGHER
lyrics:
(His Name is Higher above all other names
His Name is Jesus, His Name is Lord) 2x

His Name is so Mighty,
The Name that heals the sick
The deaf, the dumb, the blind,
And set the captives free
He has opened my eyes,
Of understanding now
The Name of Jesus, that Name is Lord.

By the Revealed Word today,
I know He’s Mighty God manifest in the flesh,
To save my (our) soul from sin
I’m resting on those Words,
Spoken by the prophet
The Name of Jesus, that Name is Lord.

title: I WILL KEEP YOU
lyrics:
Temptation’s great but the Lord
Has given you faith
To overcome, the battles won
Depends on how you see
Yourselves from day to day
Full of guilt, condemnations and shame
But God doesn’t see you that way
You just have to confess to Him
(He’ll never leave you
He’ll stay with you all the way ) 2x

Chorus

I will keep you in your times of trouble
I will keep you in your time of need
I will keep you for I’m your refuge
I will keep you for you are a part of me (2x)

Keep your eyes on the prize
Refuse to compromise
You! Esthers and Daniels for this final ride
Rise up and complete the work
That He’s bestowed on you
And just forget what you’re going through
You just do His work and He’ll do yours
We’re fighting a battle, fighting for a cause
To get all the souls that we have to find
(For God’s determined not one hoof
Will be left behind) 2x

Lord at this junction how we need
More of Your unction
To function the way You want us to
As prophesied, the Bride of Christ
Will know what God wants done
To fulfill His Word, this Eternal Truth
For we are the mystery being revealed
The Seven Seals of our lives
Are no longer sealed
(We are the Word made plain
Manifested in flesh again) 2x

title: THE STEADFAST LOVE OF THE LORD
lyrics:
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases,
His mercies never come to an end
They are new every morning, new every morning
Great is Thy faithfulness Oh! Lord
Great is Thy faithfulness.

title: WE WILL MAKE IT
lyrics:
When the enemy comes to hold you captive
Just remember the bleeding Lamb
For our freedom He was slain
We have come this far by grace
And we are going through by grace
We will make it by the grace of God

Chorus

We will make it by the grace of God (2x)
Fear not those fiery trials it’s only six inches long
We will make it by the grace of God (2x)

When we get over yonder on that beautiful shore
We would meet the saints of old
Who had gone on before
There’s a question they would ask us
Is how did we make it through
And we will say, it’s by the grace of God

The first Heaven and earth are all passed away
The Holy City is coming down on earth
With God we shall reign
God shall wipe away your tears
No more sorrows will be there
Saints! We will make it by the grace of God

title: THE JOY OF THE LORD
lyrics:
The joy of the Lord is my strength (3x)
The joy of the Lord is my strength

He fills my heart with laughter ha ha ha ha ha (3x)
The joy of the Lord is my strength

The Word of God is nigh thee, even in thy mouth (3x)
The joy of the Lord is my strength

The Spoken Word has power even in thy mouth (3x)
The joy of the Lord is my strength

He sent to me a prophet and I'm so grateful (3x)
The joy of the Lord is my strength
